professionalism and ethics of the jewelry industry.

home décor.

## American Institute of Gemological Research

AIGR, Inc.
Jewelry Appraisers Independently Serving Colorado and Beyond

[Make an Appointment][12]
* **Phone**
  (303) 420-2369

[AIGR sample diamond ring appraisal with precious metal and gemstone details.]

### [Jewelry Appraisals][13]

A jewelry appraisal identifies and evaluates a piece of jewelry, including a monetary valuation,
whether for insurance, estate, or other financial or legal purposes. Jewelry appraisals need to be
updated from time to time.

[Learn More][14]

[AIGR sample colored gemstone grading report with green tourmaline detail. ]

### [Gem Grading Reports][15]

Gemstone grading reports identify and grade a stone and include a plot of the stone’s natural
characteristics, but there is no monetary valuation given. As a result, a grading report never
expires. 

[Learn More][16]

[Gemstone and watch resource books for research and continuing professional development.]

### [Expert Consulting][17]

AIGR graduate gemologists have decades of experience examining a variety of gems and jewelry.
Therefore, we can help you classify your jewelry for estate distribution or give expert testimony in
legal cases.

[Learn More][18]

### Welcome to AIGR

The American Institute of Gemological Research (AIGR), Inc., is an independent gem lab serving the
Denver metropolitan area and Colorado front range. Our experienced appraisers will evaluate your
jewelry in our laboratory and provide printed appraisals. As a result of our professional efforts,
we guarantee that qualifications of our GIA Graduate Gemologists will be accepted by your insurance
company.

AIGR’s gemologists have provided jewelry appraisals in Denver for over twenty-five years. This
experience on top of our education makes us experts in the field of gemology with in-depth knowledge
of jewelry manufacturing and pricing. Therefore, we can provide you with peace of mind about your
jewelry and gemstones and can document their value.

We are here to help. AIGR does not buy or sell so that we remain an independent advocate for you.
Please call us at (303) 420-2369. We have appointments available Tuesday through Friday.

[Logos for American Gem Society Certified Gemologist Appraiser and National Association of Jewelry
Appraisers.]
[United States map showing over forty states with AIGR clients.] AIGR has served clients from states
shown in red.

### Reasons for getting a jewelry appraisal

Do you want to know how much your jewelry is worth before you sell it?

Have you bought gems or jewelry online and need expert verification that you bought what was
advertised?

Did you inherit jewelry and need to know its value?

Have you purchased an item from an unfamiliar jeweler or pawn shop?

Are you a jeweler who needs certificates for your gemstones?

Visit this [website][19] for more information about gemologists and gemology

.

### Next Steps…

Please contact us with questions or to make an appointment.

jewelry in our laboratory and provide printed appraisals. As a result of our professional efforts,
we guarantee that qualifications of our GIA Graduate Gemologists will be accepted by your insurance
company.

AIGR’s gemologists have provided jewelry appraisals in Denver for over twenty-five years. This
experience on top of our education makes us experts in the field of gemology with in-depth knowledge
of jewelry manufacturing and pricing. Therefore, we can provide you with peace of mind about your
jewelry and gemstones and can document their value.

We are here to help. AIGR does not buy or sell so that we remain an independent advocate for you.
Please call us at (303) 420-2369. We have appointments available Tuesday through Friday.

[Logos for American Gem Society Certified Gemologist Appraiser and National Association of Jewelry
Appraisers.]
[United States map showing over forty states with AIGR clients.] AIGR has served clients from states
shown in red.

### Reasons for getting a jewelry appraisal

Do you want to know how much your jewelry is worth before you sell it?

Have you bought gems or jewelry online and need expert verification that you bought what was
advertised?

Did you inherit jewelry and need to know its value?

Have you purchased an item from an unfamiliar jeweler or pawn shop?

Are you a jeweler who needs certificates for your gemstones?

Visit this [website][19] for more information about gemologists and gemology

.

[Allied Gem Appraisers Gold and Gemstone Earrings]

## Why Accurate Appraisals Matter
* Protect your investment with precise evaluations.

* Avoid costly mistakes in selling, insuring, or inheriting your jewelry.

* Gain peace of mind knowing the true value of your pieces.


### What We Offer 

Chicago independent jewelry appraisal services provided by a GIA Graduate Gemologist and Certified
Appraiser. Our firm prepares USPAP-compliant appraisal reports for insurance, estate, and legal
purposes. As an independent practice, we do not buy or sell jewelry, ensuring every valuation
remains objective and unbiased.

Get a detailed, professional appraisal for your records. 

## About Our Appraisal Services

At Allied Gem Appraisers, our team of experts is dedicated to providing top-tier jewelry and gem

## Why Accurate Appraisals Matter
* Protect your investment with precise evaluations.

* Avoid costly mistakes in selling, insuring, or inheriting your jewelry.

* Gain peace of mind knowing the true value of your pieces.


### What We Offer 

Chicago independent jewelry appraisal services provided by a GIA Graduate Gemologist and Certified
Appraiser. Our firm prepares USPAP-compliant appraisal reports for insurance, estate, and legal
purposes. As an independent practice, we do not buy or sell jewelry, ensuring every valuation
remains objective and unbiased.

2. Bring Your Jewelry

3. Receive Your Report


Get a detailed, professional appraisal for your records. 

## About Our Appraisal Services

At Allied Gem Appraisers, our team of experts is dedicated to providing top-tier jewelry and gem
appraisal services. With a rich history spanning over 40 years, we offer accurate and reliable
appraisals, insurance replacements, precise gem identification, and convenient online payment
options. Our personalized customer service and custom jewelry solutions ensure that each client
receives the highest level of care and expertise.

### **Loose Gem Wholesaler**

Welcome to Boston Gems, a wholesaler of fine colored gemstones operating in the Jeweler’s Exchange
Building in downtown Boston for over twenty years.

Boston Gems has an enviable collection of colored stones such as Sapphire, Ruby, Emerald, and many
more. Boston Gems also specializes in selling the highest quality Moonstone and holds one of the
largest collections in the country. Our inventory includes Indian Blue Sheen, Ceylon, Burmese, and
African Rainbow Moonstone.

We are committed to providing unmatched service, product, and knowledge to our valued customers.
Boston Gems has a commitment to fair trade practices and to disclosing gemstone treatments and
enhancements.

##### UNIQUE GEMs


### **What We Offer**

[[Ruby-Homepage]][13]

#### [Ruby ][14]

Ruby is the red to purplish-red variety of the mineral corundum that has been treasured by people
throughout the ages, and has been called the “King of Gems.” Ruby is known as a gem of power and
passion.

[[OLYMPUS DIGITAL CAMERA]][15]

#### [Moonstone][16]

Moonstone includes several types of the mineral feldspar that show adularescence, which is a glow
that seems to hover and move over the top of the stone. This effect is created by light scattering
through the different layers of the gem. Moonstone is known as a gem of vision and intuition.

[[OLYMPUS DIGITAL CAMERA]][17]

#### [Sapphire][18]

Sapphire is best known as the blue to violet-blue variety of the mineral corundum. However, it comes
in a rainbow of colors. Sapphire has been prized as a symbol of wealth and wisdom throughout the
ages.

##### gemstones

##### **Popular Stones**

## Emerald

Emerald is the green to bluish-green variety of the mineral beryl. It has been prized since the
times of ancient Egypt and was also treasured by the Incas in South America as a royal gem. Emerald
is known as a gem of love and abundance.

[Shop Emerald][19]
[emerald-shop]
[Tourmaline-shop]

## Tourmaline

Tourmaline is a mineral that comes in a rainbow of colors, sometimes within the same stone! It is
dichroic and will show different shades on different orientations of the crystal, so planning goes
into the cut in order to show the best colors of a faceted gem. Each color of tourmaline has its own
significance and meaning.

[Shop Tourmaline][20]

## Tanzanite

Tanzanite is the gem version of the mineral zoisite that shows a violetish-blue to bluish-violet
color. It was discovered in the 1960’s in Tanzania and was popularized by Tiffany & Co. Tanzanite is
known as a gem of transformation and optimism.

[Shop Tanzanite][21]
[tanzanite-wholesale]
[aquamarine-gem-boston]

## Aquamarine

Aquamarine is the blue to greenish-blue variety of the mineral beryl. It is name is related to the
sea “aqua” meaning water “marina” meaning sea. Aquamarine is known as a calming and protective gem.

[Shop Aquamarine][22]

## Opal

Opal is a mineral that is composed of hydrated silica spheres. The light scattering within the stone
causes “play of color” with bright flashes of different colors appearing as it moves. Opal is known
as a gem of luck and magic.

[Shop Opal][23]
[Opal-for-sale]
[garnet-shop]

## Garnet

Garnet is a family of related minerals that range in color from red to purple, and all the way
through orange and green. Garnet was a favorite gemstone for jewelry during the 18th and 19th
Century in Europe and is known as a spiritually grounding gem.

[Shop Garnet][24]

# Fine Jewellery Manufacturing & Gemstone Expertise from Bangkok

European-operated jewellery manufacturer based in Thailand’s Gemopolis Free Zone, specialising in
custom fine jewellery, gemstone sourcing, cutting, and precision production.

[Casa Jewels jewellery workshop in Bangkok]

Who We Are

## Modern Jewellery Manufacturing with Traditional Craftsmanship

Casa Jewels is a Bangkok-based jewellery manufacturer located in Thailand’s Gemopolis Free Zone. We
combine precise digital production, skilled bench craftsmanship, gemstone expertise, and
international standards to create fine jewellery for brands, designers, retailers, and private
clients.

From CAD development and direct casting to stone setting, polishing, quality control, and gemstone
sourcing, our workshop supports both bespoke one-off projects and small-to-medium production runs.

[ About Casa Jewels ][184]

Our Capabilities

## Jewellery Production, Gemstones & Private Label Services

01

### Custom Jewellery Manufacturing

From CAD development and casting to setting, polishing and final quality control.

02

### Gemstone Sourcing & Cutting

Natural and lab-grown gemstones, calibrated stones, recutting and precision sourcing.

03

### Stone Setting & Finishing

Careful setting, refined finishing and detailed inspection for premium jewellery pieces.

04

### Private Label Production

Small-to-medium production for jewellery brands, designers and retail partners.

Gemstone Expertise

## Gemstones Are at the Heart of What We Do

Casa Jewels works closely with natural and lab-grown gemstones, from sourcing and matching to
calibrated layouts, recutting and production-ready stone preparation.

Our gemstone knowledge allows us to support jewellery brands and designers with stones that are
selected not only for appearance, but also for proportion, consistency and production suitability.

# Fine Jewellery Manufacturing & Gemstone Expertise from Bangkok

European-operated jewellery manufacturer based in Thailand’s Gemopolis Free Zone, specialising in
custom fine jewellery, gemstone sourcing, cutting, and precision production.

Who We Are

## Modern Jewellery Manufacturing with Traditional Craftsmanship

Casa Jewels is a Bangkok-based jewellery manufacturer located in Thailand’s Gemopolis Free Zone. We
combine precise digital production, skilled bench craftsmanship, gemstone expertise, and
international standards to create fine jewellery for brands, designers, retailers, and private
clients.

From CAD development and direct casting to stone setting, polishing, quality control, and gemstone
sourcing, our workshop supports both bespoke one-off projects and small-to-medium production runs.

[ About Casa Jewels ][184]

Our Capabilities

## Jewellery Production, Gemstones & Private Label Services

01

### Custom Jewellery Manufacturing

From CAD development and casting to setting, polishing and final quality control.

02

### Gemstone Sourcing & Cutting

Natural and lab-grown gemstones, calibrated stones, recutting and precision sourcing.

03

### Stone Setting & Finishing

Careful setting, refined finishing and detailed inspection for premium jewellery pieces.

04

### Private Label Production

Small-to-medium production for jewellery brands, designers and retail partners.

Gemstone Expertise

## Gemstones Are at the Heart of What We Do

Casa Jewels works closely with natural and lab-grown gemstones, from sourcing and matching to
calibrated layouts, recutting and production-ready stone preparation.

Our gemstone knowledge allows us to support jewellery brands and designers with stones that are
selected not only for appearance, but also for proportion, consistency and production suitability.

# The *Original* Architects of the Gem Growing Industry

 Over 80 years ago, Carroll Chatham introduced the world to laboratory grown emeralds. By
duplicating the conditions deep within the earth, his laboratory succeeded in growing the finest
gems over the course of a year’s time. A discovery so unique, it remains a carefully guarded
corporate secret to this day. Chatham is now recognized worldwide as the industry leader in luxury
laboratory grown gemstones and diamond jewelry.

### *Diamond* Fashion

If diamonds are a girl's best friend, then lab-grown diamonds are a modern woman's "ride-or-die."
Discover sparkle grown with purpose and meant for forever.

[ shop now ][51]

## The Big Three



### Ruby

*Bold red. Pure confidence.*

Ignite your story with the passionate brilliance of Chatham lab-grown ruby. Because self-expression
should shine as boldly as you do.

[ EXPLORE jewelry][52]



### Sapphire

*True blue. Forever classic.*

Rich, velvety hues. Unmatched clarity. Chatham lab-grown sapphire is more than a classic—it's a
canvas for your individuality.

[ EXPLORE jewelry][53]



### Emerald

*Lush green. Brilliantly grown.*

Chatham lab-grown emeralds evoke vitality, renewal and the richness of life. Inspired by nature and
destined to turn heads.

[ explore jewelry][54]

### *Color* Engagement Rings

Your love is a work of art. From ruby reds to sapphire blues and emerald greens, each piece reflects
a feeling, a memory, a moment. Paint your own masterpiece with the lab-grown gemstone that brings
your love to life.

[ shop now ][55]

### *High* Jewelry

Rich color. Flawless craftsmanship. Inspired by the women who've defined history. Created for those
defining their own. Introducing designs that mark the moment—and live beyond it.

[ shop now ][56]

### *Spring/Summer* Jewelry Trends

The soft blush of spring flowers in verdant fields. The serene yet vivid greens and blues of a
tropical sea. No one does color like nature, and no one captures it like Chatham. Bring the most
stunning tones of spring and summer to your jewelry box with the season’s most popular jewelry
styles.

[ LEARN MORE ][57]

## Our Promises To You



### Lifetime Warranty

We want everyone who purchases a Chatham lab grown gemstone to know our guarantee and the quality we
stand behind.



### Never Mined

With our planet and neighbors in mind, Chatham strictly follows ethical and responsible growth.



### Pure Brilliance

Combining advanced technology with impeccable design to ensure the highest quality gemstones and
jewelry.

### *Responsible* Luxury

tree through our partnership with One Tree Planted.

# The *Original* Architects of the Gem Growing Industry

 Over 80 years ago, Carroll Chatham introduced the world to laboratory grown emeralds. By
duplicating the conditions deep within the earth, his laboratory succeeded in growing the finest
gems over the course of a year’s time. A discovery so unique, it remains a carefully guarded
corporate secret to this day. Chatham is now recognized worldwide as the industry leader in luxury
laboratory grown gemstones and diamond jewelry.



## SHOP FEATURED CATEGORIES

### *Diamond* Fashion

If diamonds are a girl's best friend, then lab-grown diamonds are a modern woman's "ride-or-die."
Discover sparkle grown with purpose and meant for forever.

[ shop now ][51]

## The Big Three



### Ruby

*Bold red. Pure confidence.*

Ignite your story with the passionate brilliance of Chatham lab-grown ruby. Because self-expression
should shine as boldly as you do.

[ EXPLORE jewelry][52]



### Sapphire

*True blue. Forever classic.*

Rich, velvety hues. Unmatched clarity. Chatham lab-grown sapphire is more than a classic—it's a
canvas for your individuality.

[ EXPLORE jewelry][53]



### Emerald

*Lush green. Brilliantly grown.*

Chatham lab-grown emeralds evoke vitality, renewal and the richness of life. Inspired by nature and
destined to turn heads.

[ explore jewelry][54]

### *Color* Engagement Rings

Your love is a work of art. From ruby reds to sapphire blues and emerald greens, each piece reflects
a feeling, a memory, a moment. Paint your own masterpiece with the lab-grown gemstone that brings
your love to life.

[ shop now ][55]

### *High* Jewelry

Rich color. Flawless craftsmanship. Inspired by the women who've defined history. Created for those
defining their own. Introducing designs that mark the moment—and live beyond it.

[ shop now ][56]

### *Spring/Summer* Jewelry Trends

The soft blush of spring flowers in verdant fields. The serene yet vivid greens and blues of a
tropical sea. No one does color like nature, and no one captures it like Chatham. Bring the most
stunning tones of spring and summer to your jewelry box with the season’s most popular jewelry
styles.

[ LEARN MORE ][57]

## Our Promises To You



### Lifetime Warranty

We want everyone who purchases a Chatham lab grown gemstone to know our guarantee and the quality we
stand behind.



### Never Mined

With our planet and neighbors in mind, Chatham strictly follows ethical and responsible growth.



### Pure Brilliance

Combining advanced technology with impeccable design to ensure the highest quality gemstones and
jewelry.

### *Responsible* Luxury

Your browser does not support the video tag.

For every purchase made, Chatham takes a significant step towards a greener planet by planting a
tree through our partnership with One Tree Planted.

Your browser does not support the video tag.

We’ve never mined a single diamond from African soil, but we’re still helping. Our partnership is
dedicated to saving the African Elephant population and helping the children who live near them.

### Gems

Die Marke für exklusive Edelsteine Constantin Wilds Gem Room ist ein besonderer Ort: eine
Schatztruhe, die die kostbarsten Edelsteine der Welt in sich birgt. In den schönsten Farben
leuchtend, stehen sie als Symbol für die Emotionen, die Liebhaber und Kenner nie wieder loslässt.
Mehr erfahren ][21]
[ Unsere Vision Wir haben uns zum Ziel gesetzt, der meist respektierte und zuverlässigste Partner
für Schmuckmarken und -designer in der Welt außergewöhnlicher Edelsteine zu sein. Mehr erfahren

### Trust

][22]
[

### Wild

Unsere Mission Über zehn Generationen eint meine Vorfahren und mich ein gleicher Gedanke: der
immerwährende Wunsch, den Farben der seltensten Edelsteine dieser Welt ihr kostbarstes Strahlen zu
entlocken, um ihren wahren Luxus zu offenbaren: die natürliche Schönheit einzigartiger Emotionen.
Mehr erfahren ][23]

> award-winning, 1-8 player mining sandbox adventure, your choices shape an epic journey. Harvest
> relics and resources, craft advanced tools, build your base, and explore a dynamically evolving
> world waiting to be unearthed.

published by [Fireshine Games][103]. It is currently available on Windows, Linux, PlayStation 4,

## Sedex Certified Jewelry Manufacturer to the SMETA 4-Pillar Standard

DWS Jewellery is audited against the SMETA 4-Pillar standard (Labour, Health & Safety, Environment
and Ethical Business), which impacts what happens at the factory on a daily basis vs. simply being a
formality for audits.

So when an international buyer is sourcing from a factory that has been SMETA 4-Pillar compliant,
then they can be assured that their compliance requirements will also be met and that the factory
would support responsible sourcing, working toward more transparency in their operations and
providing safe working conditions along their supply chain.

### Agreement with RJC (Responsible Jewelry Council)

Adhering to, and following the RJC Code of Practices ensures that our company implements systems to
track the silver, gold & gemstones to establish a systematic method for sourcing ethically,
respecting human rights, providing for the environment and operational transparency. We have clearly
defined supplier compliance and a stronger responsible sourcing story with the use of the RJC Code
of Practices for our gold vermeil and 9K/14K gold demi-fine jewelry.

### Indian Government Recognised Star Export House

DWS Jewellery is a recognised Star Export House by the Government of India. The company has an
exceptional track record in exporting products and developing an efficient quality export process
that has proven successful all over the world. DWS receives the benefits of being a Star Export
House, including faster and more efficient documentation and processing, and more reliable shipment
of goods due to its status as a Star Export House. At DWS, our experienced export team understands,
and is aware of, the international hallmarking Regulations and what is necessary to correctly comply
with the regulations for Jewelry being shipped to customers in all parts of the world.



### A Guide to Sustainable, Ethical and Solar-Powered Manufacturing

Our manufacturing method is focused on three areas; it is ethical, it is sustainable and it is
generated by solar energy. This means that the factory runs on solar power alone and uses no other
sources of energy. We use the in-house Effluent Treatment Plant (ETP) to monitor the use of water,
and we are committed to treating, reusing and recycling all by-products of our manufacturing process
in an environmentally responsible manner.

Our facility is equipped with integrated manufacturing systems so that we can adhere to the
project's commitment to being environmentally aware over the long term, while also providing
assistance to the global retail and market partners we work with to meet their sustainability
requirements.


### ODM Jewelry Design Services

DWS provides ODM (original designer manufacturer) services for brand names looking for a complete
collection of jewelry to manufacture. Our in-house Designers develop complete collections from
Concept Development/Trend Research through Computer Aided Design (CAD), Sampling and Production.

We design all types of rings; Earrings; Pendants; Bracelets; Necklaces and Cuffs in all types of
Jewelry including; Sterling Silver; Demi-Fine; Gold Vermeil; 9K Gold and 14K Gold. This allows our
clients to develop and create new Collections and thereby eliminate the need to hire large internal
Design teams.


### OEM & Private Label manufacturing

Brands that already have existing designs can have DWS manufacture jewelry using either OEM or
private label methods. We will convert sketches, CAD files, or sample pieces (both written and
visual) of your design into actual production pieces using the specifications you provide. We will
work closely with you to finalize everything about the specifications before commencing mass
production. We will come together to develop specifications that include: Metal content (pure versus
plated), Stone grading (size, color, etc.), Plating thickness, Weight tolerances, and Finishing
standards. Our dedicated teams of support, both account and technical, will assist with this and
make sure there is a good understanding of the specifications and consistent results.


### We Create Wide Range of Products

We manufacture a variety of items. DWS can manufacture jewelry in a variety of metals, including:
* Sterling Silver
* Demi-Fine Jewelry
* Vermeil Jewelry
* Solid Gold (9K & 14K)
* Gemstone(s) Jewelry
* Fashion Jewelry
DWS manufactures all our ethically sourced gemstones (precious and semi-precious) from beginning to
end. We are responsible for the gemstone’s initial source, its cut, how it is set into your
jewellery item, and the final finish of the gemstone. This means that through the entire production
process, you will see the same quality and consistency visually.


### The Capabilities of Making Both Demi-fine Jewellery and Gold Vermeil

As a result of DWS extensive experience working with gold vermeil and demi-fine jewelry, we utilize
sterling silver as the base metal and using quality gold to plate our products that hold their color
over long periods of time without showing sign of wear and without having to worry about the
degradation of the gold. A collection of products that link fashion to Fine Jewelry that is perfect
for High End Fashion, ecommerce businesses, and Fine Jewelry Brands that have an up-to-date style of
finish or Designer Aesthetic who would like to allow the brands to be recognized as "Affordable
Luxury" by all of their customers.

We base our collection development on market research for worldwide trends in the Jewelry Industry;
consumer behavior with regards to jewelry; and the success of retailers in this business. However,
we are also influenced by the trends in Fashion from Country to Country, the style of buildings in
each Country, the designs of culturally significant symbols, and the presence of simple clean lines
in general.

We take all of these elements into consideration in order to help our partners develop a
Commercially Viable versatile collection that will continue to grow and be aligned with what trends
and demand exist, across many different global environments.

All of the processes we use to create our collections are being continually improved due to the
implementation of modern technologies (CAD, 3D Printing, CNC Machining, etc.) which has resulted in
improved consistency, fewer errors, and the ability to repeat our production in larger numbers.

Despite being a mass manufacturing process, the artisan quality of the product is maintained through
the finishing techniques used in the process. Each item will retain its handmade look and feel no
matter how many are produced. All quality control and compliance measures are adhered to during the
entire production process of every product manufactured, including inspections of incoming raw

## Sedex Certified Jewelry Manufacturer to the SMETA 4-Pillar Standard

DWS Jewellery is audited against the SMETA 4-Pillar standard (Labour, Health & Safety, Environment
and Ethical Business), which impacts what happens at the factory on a daily basis vs. simply being a
formality for audits.

So when an international buyer is sourcing from a factory that has been SMETA 4-Pillar compliant,
then they can be assured that their compliance requirements will also be met and that the factory
would support responsible sourcing, working toward more transparency in their operations and
providing safe working conditions along their supply chain.

### Agreement with RJC (Responsible Jewelry Council)

Adhering to, and following the RJC Code of Practices ensures that our company implements systems to
track the silver, gold & gemstones to establish a systematic method for sourcing ethically,
respecting human rights, providing for the environment and operational transparency. We have clearly
defined supplier compliance and a stronger responsible sourcing story with the use of the RJC Code
of Practices for our gold vermeil and 9K/14K gold demi-fine jewelry.

### Indian Government Recognised Star Export House

DWS Jewellery is a recognised Star Export House by the Government of India. The company has an
exceptional track record in exporting products and developing an efficient quality export process
that has proven successful all over the world. DWS receives the benefits of being a Star Export
House, including faster and more efficient documentation and processing, and more reliable shipment
of goods due to its status as a Star Export House. At DWS, our experienced export team understands,
and is aware of, the international hallmarking Regulations and what is necessary to correctly comply
with the regulations for Jewelry being shipped to customers in all parts of the world.



### A Guide to Sustainable, Ethical and Solar-Powered Manufacturing

Our manufacturing method is focused on three areas; it is ethical, it is sustainable and it is
generated by solar energy. This means that the factory runs on solar power alone and uses no other
sources of energy. We use the in-house Effluent Treatment Plant (ETP) to monitor the use of water,
and we are committed to treating, reusing and recycling all by-products of our manufacturing process
in an environmentally responsible manner.

Our facility is equipped with integrated manufacturing systems so that we can adhere to the
project's commitment to being environmentally aware over the long term, while also providing
assistance to the global retail and market partners we work with to meet their sustainability
requirements.


### ODM Jewelry Design Services

DWS provides ODM (original designer manufacturer) services for brand names looking for a complete
collection of jewelry to manufacture. Our in-house Designers develop complete collections from
Concept Development/Trend Research through Computer Aided Design (CAD), Sampling and Production.

We design all types of rings; Earrings; Pendants; Bracelets; Necklaces and Cuffs in all types of
Jewelry including; Sterling Silver; Demi-Fine; Gold Vermeil; 9K Gold and 14K Gold. This allows our
clients to develop and create new Collections and thereby eliminate the need to hire large internal
Design teams.


### OEM & Private Label manufacturing

Brands that already have existing designs can have DWS manufacture jewelry using either OEM or
private label methods. We will convert sketches, CAD files, or sample pieces (both written and
visual) of your design into actual production pieces using the specifications you provide. We will
work closely with you to finalize everything about the specifications before commencing mass
production. We will come together to develop specifications that include: Metal content (pure versus
plated), Stone grading (size, color, etc.), Plating thickness, Weight tolerances, and Finishing
standards. Our dedicated teams of support, both account and technical, will assist with this and
make sure there is a good understanding of the specifications and consistent results.


### We Create Wide Range of Products

We manufacture a variety of items. DWS can manufacture jewelry in a variety of metals, including:
* Sterling Silver
* Demi-Fine Jewelry
* Vermeil Jewelry
* Solid Gold (9K & 14K)
* Gemstone(s) Jewelry
* Fashion Jewelry
DWS manufactures all our ethically sourced gemstones (precious and semi-precious) from beginning to
end. We are responsible for the gemstone’s initial source, its cut, how it is set into your
jewellery item, and the final finish of the gemstone. This means that through the entire production
process, you will see the same quality and consistency visually.


### The Capabilities of Making Both Demi-fine Jewellery and Gold Vermeil

As a result of DWS extensive experience working with gold vermeil and demi-fine jewelry, we utilize
sterling silver as the base metal and using quality gold to plate our products that hold their color
over long periods of time without showing sign of wear and without having to worry about the
degradation of the gold. A collection of products that link fashion to Fine Jewelry that is perfect
for High End Fashion, ecommerce businesses, and Fine Jewelry Brands that have an up-to-date style of
finish or Designer Aesthetic who would like to allow the brands to be recognized as "Affordable
Luxury" by all of their customers.

We base our collection development on market research for worldwide trends in the Jewelry Industry;
consumer behavior with regards to jewelry; and the success of retailers in this business. However,
we are also influenced by the trends in Fashion from Country to Country, the style of buildings in
each Country, the designs of culturally significant symbols, and the presence of simple clean lines
in general.

We take all of these elements into consideration in order to help our partners develop a
Commercially Viable versatile collection that will continue to grow and be aligned with what trends
and demand exist, across many different global environments.

All of the processes we use to create our collections are being continually improved due to the
implementation of modern technologies (CAD, 3D Printing, CNC Machining, etc.) which has resulted in
improved consistency, fewer errors, and the ability to repeat our production in larger numbers.

Despite being a mass manufacturing process, the artisan quality of the product is maintained through
the finishing techniques used in the process. Each item will retain its handmade look and feel no
matter how many are produced. All quality control and compliance measures are adhered to during the

## Gemstone Rough Sourcing

Our gemstones are sourced through a responsible and transparent procurement process from trusted
mines, suppliers, and trading partners. We prioritise ethical sourcing practices, ensuring
compliance with applicable regulations, traceability standards, and sustainable business principles.

## Rough Selection & Sorting

After sourcing, gemstones are carefully sorted based on color, clarity, size, shape, quality,
inclusions, and transparency. Each stone is assessed for its cutting potential and categorized
accordingly, ensuring efficient processing and consistent quality throughout the manufacturing
process. Low-quality gemstones are separated from premium-grade material.

## Cutting & Shaping

Selected rough gemstones are carefully cut and shaped by skilled artisans to maximize their natural
beauty and value. Each stone is processed with precision to achieve the desired shape, symmetry, and
proportions while preserving its quality and enhancing its potential for brilliance.

## Facets & Polished

Following the cutting and shaping process, gemstones are expertly faceted to enhance their
brilliance and light reflection, with careful attention to symmetry and proportions. They are then
polished to achieve a smooth, high-lustre finish, revealing their natural beauty and ensuring a
premium-quality appearance.

## Quality Check

Upon completion of the cutting, faceting, and polishing stages, every gemstone undergoes a thorough
quality check to verify dimensions, shape, polish, symmetry, color, clarity, and overall finish.
Each stone is inspected against strict quality standards to ensure consistency, accuracy, and
excellence before it is approved for shipment and final packing.

## Secure Packing

Approved gemstones are securely packed using protective materials, including pouches, bubble wrap,
and boxes, to safeguard their quality during transit. Each shipment is carefully labelled, verified,
and prepared according to established packing standards, ensuring safe and reliable delivery to
customers worldwide.

## Ship with Trusted Delivery Partners

Gemstones are securely packed, labeled, and verified before shipment. We work with trusted delivery
partners to ensure safe, timely, and reliable transportation, allowing each order to reach its
destination in perfect condition. Products are shipped worldwide through secure courier services
like UPS Fedex with required documentation.

## Gemstone Rough Sourcing

Our gemstones are sourced through a responsible and transparent procurement process from trusted
mines, suppliers, and trading partners. We prioritise ethical sourcing practices, ensuring
compliance with applicable regulations, traceability standards, and sustainable business principles.

## Rough Selection & Sorting

After sourcing, gemstones are carefully sorted based on color, clarity, size, shape, quality,
inclusions, and transparency. Each stone is assessed for its cutting potential and categorized
accordingly, ensuring efficient processing and consistent quality throughout the manufacturing
process. Low-quality gemstones are separated from premium-grade material.

## Cutting & Shaping

Selected rough gemstones are carefully cut and shaped by skilled artisans to maximize their natural
beauty and value. Each stone is processed with precision to achieve the desired shape, symmetry, and
proportions while preserving its quality and enhancing its potential for brilliance.

## Facets & Polished

Following the cutting and shaping process, gemstones are expertly faceted to enhance their
brilliance and light reflection, with careful attention to symmetry and proportions. They are then
polished to achieve a smooth, high-lustre finish, revealing their natural beauty and ensuring a
premium-quality appearance.

## Quality Check

Upon completion of the cutting, faceting, and polishing stages, every gemstone undergoes a thorough
quality check to verify dimensions, shape, polish, symmetry, color, clarity, and overall finish.
Each stone is inspected against strict quality standards to ensure consistency, accuracy, and
excellence before it is approved for shipment and final packing.

## Secure Packing

Approved gemstones are securely packed using protective materials, including pouches, bubble wrap,
and boxes, to safeguard their quality during transit. Each shipment is carefully labelled, verified,
and prepared according to established packing standards, ensuring safe and reliable delivery to
customers worldwide.

## Ship with Trusted Delivery Partners

Gemstones are securely packed, labeled, and verified before shipment. We work with trusted delivery
partners to ensure safe, timely, and reliable transportation, allowing each order to reach its
destination in perfect condition. Products are shipped worldwide through secure courier services
like UPS Fedex with required documentation.

[[Marble]][240]

### [Marble][241]

Marble Countertops – Classic Luxury for Kitchens & Bathrooms, it is a metamorphic rock formed from
limestone under heat and pressure, composed mainly of calcite. It is renowned for its elegance,
durability, and unique veining patterns.

[[Granite]][242]

### [Granite][243]

Granite Countertops – Timeless Strength & Beauty, it is a durable, heat-resistant, and
scratch-resistant natural stone, making it ideal for countertops, flooring, and architectural
features. Its unique grain patterns and wide range of colors add elegance to any space.

[[Quartzite]][244]

### [Quartzite][245]

Quartzite Countertops - Luxury Decor for your house, it is a hard, non-foliated metamorphic rock
composed almost entirely of quartz. It forms when quartz-rich sandstone undergoes metamorphism,
resulting in a dense, durable stone with a smooth fracture.

[[Limestone]][246]

### [Limestone][247]

Limestone is a sedimentary rock primarily composed of calcium carbonate (CaCO₃), often in the form
of calcite or aragonite. It typically forms in marine environments through the accumulation of shell
fragments and other organic materials. Limestone is commonly used in construction, agriculture, and
industry.

[[Travertine]][248]

### [Travertine][249]

Travertine is a sedimentary rock primarily composed of calcium carbonate, formed through the
precipitation of minerals from water, often in hot springs. It is characterized by its porous
texture, which can be filled or left unfilled, depending on the desired aesthetic.

[[Marble]][240]

### [Marble][241]

Marble Countertops – Classic Luxury for Kitchens & Bathrooms, it is a metamorphic rock formed from
limestone under heat and pressure, composed mainly of calcite. It is renowned for its elegance,
durability, and unique veining patterns.

[[Granite]][242]

### [Granite][243]

Granite Countertops – Timeless Strength & Beauty, it is a durable, heat-resistant, and
scratch-resistant natural stone, making it ideal for countertops, flooring, and architectural
features. Its unique grain patterns and wide range of colors add elegance to any space.

[[Quartzite]][244]

### [Quartzite][245]

Quartzite Countertops - Luxury Decor for your house, it is a hard, non-foliated metamorphic rock
composed almost entirely of quartz. It forms when quartz-rich sandstone undergoes metamorphism,
resulting in a dense, durable stone with a smooth fracture.

[[Limestone]][246]

### [Limestone][247]

Limestone is a sedimentary rock primarily composed of calcium carbonate (CaCO₃), often in the form
of calcite or aragonite. It typically forms in marine environments through the accumulation of shell
fragments and other organic materials. Limestone is commonly used in construction, agriculture, and
industry.

[[Travertine]][248]

### [Travertine][249]

Travertine is a sedimentary rock primarily composed of calcium carbonate, formed through the
precipitation of minerals from water, often in hot springs. It is characterized by its porous
texture, which can be filled or left unfilled, depending on the desired aesthetic.

## Award-Winning Custom Jewellery Manufacturer India, Jaipur

Partnering with Brands & Designers Since 1999, Awarded for our exceptional quality & on time
delivery.

### Our Infrastructure & Handcrafted Mastery

Have worked with more than **400+ designers & brands **across **30 countries **and have been
consistently recognised for exceptional quality & on-time delivery.
* State-of-the-art **German Casting Plant & Machinery**
* Team of **950+ skilled craftsmen** & 100+ quality assurance experts.
* A dedicated team of **40+ Experienced CAD** professionals
* Engineered for a daily output of **6,000+ jewelry pieces.**
* State-of-the-art **German laser soldering & marking** machines.
* Equipped with **German plating** machinery & advanced **German XRF Machine**.
* Utilizing premium **German & Swiss plating Solutions** for exceptional quality.
* Extensive in-house gemstone manufacturing offering over **250+ natural & lab-grown gemstones.**

[Watch Our Factory Tour][58]

## Our Sustainability Promise

Crafting a Greener Future with Sustainable and Ethical handcrafted Jewelry

* A **Certified Green Factory**, upholding stringent environmental standards in daily operations and
  workplace conditions.
* A **Certified Sustainable Workforce by SEDEX-4 Pillar**, ensuring high standards in labor
  practices, health and safety, environmental performance, and ethics throughout the factory.
* **Certified Recycled Silver**, Verified by SGS, an independent team to reduce the environmental
  footprint to minimise harm to ecosystems.
* **Solar-Powered Energy**, our factory features a robust 120kW solar panel system, producing over
  186,782 kWh of clean energy annually by harnessing the power of the sun.
* **Advance Wastewater Treatment technology (STP/ETP)** is utilized to recycle and reuse water
  within the factory, significantly reducing overall water consumption.
* An **Advanced Waste Management System** to manage hazardous chemical waste, ensuring proper
  disposal to protect the environment.

[Watch Our Factory Tour][59]

## Our Certifications

These certifications stand as a testament to our unwavering dedication to delivering unparalleled
quality and customer satisfaction in the realm of jewelry manufacturing.

260+
Happy Designers & Brands

* **FAMA Certification:** Officially Certified by Walt Disney for manufacturing Disney and
  Disney-licensed jewelry.
* **ISO 9001:2015:** Meets the international standard for quality management systems.
* **Sedex 4-Pillar:**Ensures high standards in labor, health and safety, environment, and ethics.
* **Green Energy Management (GEM) Certification:**Our sustainable building practices in India align
  with global initiatives to combat climate change and promote environmental stewardship.
* **Carbon Accounting and ESG:** Active in carbon accounting and ESG efforts; report and targets to
  be published by year-end.
* **Certified to ISO 45001:2018**, we prioritize the highest standards of occupational health and
  safety in our jewelry manufacturing process.
* **Certified to ISO 14001:2015**, we are committed to sustainable and environmentally responsible
  jewelry manufacturing practices.
* **Certified to ISO 16732-1:2012**, we implement rigorous fire safety engineering and risk
  assessment in our jewelry manufacturing facilities
* We source both** silver & gold certified as recycled by SGS**, to reduce the environmental
  footprint to minimise harm to ecosystems.

[Watch Our Factory Tour][60]

## Our Customers Across The World

**We specialize in custom manufacturing for brands and designers across Denmark, Norway, the USA,
the UK, Sweden, Australia, and beyond.**

* **Established Demi-Fine Jewelry Brands:** High-quality yet affordable jewelry that bridges the gap

### Our Infrastructure & Handcrafted Mastery

Have worked with more than **400+ designers & brands **across **30 countries **and have been
consistently recognised for exceptional quality & on-time delivery.
* State-of-the-art **German Casting Plant & Machinery**
* Team of **950+ skilled craftsmen** & 100+ quality assurance experts.

* Engineered for a daily output of **6,000+ jewelry pieces.**
* State-of-the-art **German laser soldering & marking** machines.
* Equipped with **German plating** machinery & advanced **German XRF Machine**.
* Utilizing premium **German & Swiss plating Solutions** for exceptional quality.
* Extensive in-house gemstone manufacturing offering over **250+ natural & lab-grown gemstones.**

[Watch Our Factory Tour][58]

## Our Sustainability Promise

Crafting a Greener Future with Sustainable and Ethical handcrafted Jewelry

* A **Certified Green Factory**, upholding stringent environmental standards in daily operations and
  workplace conditions.
* A **Certified Sustainable Workforce by SEDEX-4 Pillar**, ensuring high standards in labor
  practices, health and safety, environmental performance, and ethics throughout the factory.
* **Certified Recycled Silver**, Verified by SGS, an independent team to reduce the environmental
  footprint to minimise harm to ecosystems.
* **Solar-Powered Energy**, our factory features a robust 120kW solar panel system, producing over
  186,782 kWh of clean energy annually by harnessing the power of the sun.
* **Advance Wastewater Treatment technology (STP/ETP)** is utilized to recycle and reuse water
  within the factory, significantly reducing overall water consumption.
* An **Advanced Waste Management System** to manage hazardous chemical waste, ensuring proper
  disposal to protect the environment.

[Watch Our Factory Tour][59]

quality and customer satisfaction in the realm of jewelry manufacturing.

* **Carbon Accounting and ESG:** Active in carbon accounting and ESG efforts; report and targets to

* **Certified to ISO 45001:2018**, we prioritize the highest standards of occupational health and

* **Certified to ISO 14001:2015**, we are committed to sustainable and environmentally responsible

* **Certified to ISO 16732-1:2012**, we implement rigorous fire safety engineering and risk

* We source both** silver & gold certified as recycled by SGS**, to reduce the environmental

[ [Operationalising AI in payments testing] ][198]

Event Report

### [Operationalising AI in payments testing][199]

Navigating deterministic gates and human accountability  In the world of payments — with 24/7 rails,
instant schemes, ISO 20022 migration, richer data payloads, and tighter fraud and sanctions controls
— complexity is rising while delivery windows shrink. In this context, the question for senior
leaders is not whether to use AI, but how it fits in a controlled testing architecture.  When it
comes to payments testing, AI can deliver immediate value by accelerating code creation, test-case
design, data translation and synthetic data creation for ISO 20022 environments, and 24/7 operations
support. Yet in order to achieve these benefits, financial institutions need to create tight
guardrails to ensure hallucination risk is mitigated, and auditability remains throughout.  This
report highlights the key takeaways of a Finextra webinar, hosted in association with Unifits, by a
panel of industry experts. We discuss:  Where AI is already providing value in payments testing; 
How FIs can ensure auditable and explainable AI model orchestration;  ISO 20022 as a case study for
AI in payments testing.

[ [Operationalising AI in payments testing] ][198]

Event Report

### [Operationalising AI in payments testing][199]

Navigating deterministic gates and human accountability  In the world of payments — with 24/7 rails,
instant schemes, ISO 20022 migration, richer data payloads, and tighter fraud and sanctions controls
— complexity is rising while delivery windows shrink. In this context, the question for senior
leaders is not whether to use AI, but how it fits in a controlled testing architecture.  When it
comes to payments testing, AI can deliver immediate value by accelerating code creation, test-case
design, data translation and synthetic data creation for ISO 20022 environments, and 24/7 operations
support. Yet in order to achieve these benefits, financial institutions need to create tight
guardrails to ensure hallucination risk is mitigated, and auditability remains throughout.  This
report highlights the key takeaways of a Finextra webinar, hosted in association with Unifits, by a
panel of industry experts. We discuss:  Where AI is already providing value in payments testing; 
How FIs can ensure auditable and explainable AI model orchestration;  ISO 20022 as a case study for
AI in payments testing.

experience and knowledge in crafting unique, entirely custom-designed jewelry using the finest
quality materials available. No matter your budget, if you are searching for something truly one of
a kind, we have the resources necessary to bring your ideas to life. We understand that each
individual has their unique vision, and we are committed to realizing that vision in exquisite
detail.

and gemstone repair services using only the most advanced techniques and highest quality materials.
We understand how meaningful your jewelry is to you and treat every piece as if it were our own. You
may be wondering, “can this be fixed?” Yes, it can.

for repair without leaving your home. Please [email us][81] or make an in-person appointment to

specialize in bespoke [Jewelry][210] production, setting the standard for innovation and quality. At

of Gemstones, Jewelry, Silver adornments, and a myriad of [Precious Stones][211] including Loose and

and consistency in every piece, earning accolades both domestically and internationally. Driven by a
quest for perfection, we've cultivated a modern quality management system aligned with global
standards, underscoring our pledge to deliver unparalleled products and services. Our unwavering

characterized by professional integrity, premium offerings, and competitive pricing. From bustling
cities across China to discerning clientele in Europe and the Middle East, our products resonate
with sophistication and charm. Embracing customization, we enthusiastically welcome OEM and ODM
orders, inviting collaboration to bring your unique visions to life. Whether you seek inspiration
from our curated catalog or require tailored solutions, our dedicated customer service center stands
ready to assist. We extend a warm invitation to patrons near and far, inviting you to embark on a
journey of partnership as we collectively illuminate a radiant future.

About Us
Introducing Guangzhou Qinfa Crafts, a pinnacle of elegance and expertise since its establishment in
2016. Our distinguished design team, coupled with state-of-the-art equipment, epitomizes our
commitment to excellence. Nestled in the heart of Guangzhou with seamless accessibility, we
specialize in bespoke [Jewelry][210] production, setting the standard for innovation and quality. At
the core of our ethos lies an unwavering dedication to the craft, meticulously exploring the realms
of Gemstones, Jewelry, Silver adornments, and a myriad of [Precious Stones][211] including Loose and
Synthetic Gemstones. Leveraging cutting-edge CNC machine equipment, we ensure unparalleled precision
and consistency in every piece, earning accolades both domestically and internationally. Driven by a
quest for perfection, we've cultivated a modern quality management system aligned with global
standards, underscoring our pledge to deliver unparalleled products and services. Our unwavering
commitment to fostering mutually beneficial relationships has garnered us a sterling reputation,
characterized by professional integrity, premium offerings, and competitive pricing. From bustling
cities across China to discerning clientele in Europe and the Middle East, our products resonate
with sophistication and charm. Embracing customization, we enthusiastically welcome OEM and ODM
orders, inviting collaboration to bring your unique visions to life. Whether you seek inspiration
from our curated catalog or require tailored solutions, our dedicated customer service center stands
ready to assist. We extend a warm invitation to patrons near and far, inviting you to embark on a
journey of partnership as we collectively illuminate a radiant future.

# Gem Appraisals Unlimited LLC

Gem Appraisals Unlimited LLC is your trusted source for all types of fine jewelry and gemstone
valuations serving the Greater Los Angeles area, including the Inland Empire and Desert Communities
of California.

Whether you have fine gold and diamond jewelry, gemstones of every kind, modern or vintage
timepieces, pearls and precious metals, all your valuation needs can be handled expertly and
accurately at Gem Appraisals Unlimited LLC.

Master Gemologist-Appraiser Teri Newman Brossmer has over 30 years’ experience in fine jewelry
appraisal. Her many credentials and continuing education have made her the most trusted source for
jewelry appraising in the region. Clients include private jewelry owners, insurance companies,
attorneys, Federal and State agencies, police departments, plus pawn shops and retailers.

put a chain through the stone, we can do that.

[ [A photo of the finished carved Quartz after it was mounted in the pin.]][92] [ [Photo of a broken

We are able to restore antique one of a kind pieces that many gem cutting shops will not attempt. We
have been able to restore intricate gem carvings originally produced by the famous shop of Cartier.

[ [Small photo of pink stone after re-cutting.]][95] [ [Small photo of windowed pink stone.]][96]

We have also developed a reputation over the years for being experts in cutting all types of star
gem stones. From star sapphires to star ruby and star diopside to star quartz. We can re-shape stars
which may not have been properly shaped when they were originally cut. This usually improves the
star.

We cut many forms of cats eyes, from cat's eye chrysoberyl to cat's eye tourmaline.

### [**Repairing Fantasy Cut Gemstones**][97]

[ [Small photo of ring inlaid with blue stones.]][98]

We repair Munsteiner cuts and other forms of fantasy cuts. Fantasy cuts are a unique type of gem
cutting which requires unique lapidary techniques to work on them.

### [Gemstone **Watch Dials**][99]

[ [Small photo of ring inlaid with blue stones.]][100]

Over the years we have made watch dials for a variety of watches such as Rolex, Patek Philippe,
Piaget and others. We have made them from materials such as Lapis, Black Onyx, Mother of Pearl,
Tiger Eye, and Dinosaur bone.

### [**Gemstone Materials**][101]

[ [Small photo of ring inlaid with blue stones.]][102]

We have a large stock of the materials commonly used in our projects, so we can get right to work on
most projects without having to order the required materials. We are a full service lapidary shop!

### [**Repolishing GIA Refractometers**][103]

[ [Small photo of ring inlaid with blue stones.]][104]

After a refractometer has been used for a number of years the soft glass of the hemicylinder can get
scratched and pitted which makes it very difficult to get a good reading. New refractometers are
very expensive. We are able to re-polish the top surface of the glass and make them like new again..

We offer a wide range of gemstones, with a specialization in sapphires, rubies, alexandrites,

‍

As gemstone enthusiasts, we embarked on a journey to find the right suppliers directly in the heart
of the sapphire trade of Sri Lanka, where we discovered immense natural beauty. We also recognized a
great opportunity to collaborate with mine owners who genuinely prioritize ethical practices towards
their employees, supporting local communities and infrastructure.

**SUSTAINABLE MINING**
‍

We believe in sustainable mining practices, which is why we focus on smaller-scale mines that have a
minimal environmental impact compared to large industrial operations. The gemstones we offer mainly
come from smaller mines and companies located in the northern and southern regions of Sri Lanka.
These mines extract a smaller quantity of gemstones on average while maintaining respect for nature.

# Ethical Gemstone Production & Global Distribution Network

**From mine to market: zero-waste processing, environmental leadership, and premium gemstone
products from Peru.**

**Mining – Processing – Manufacturing – Global Distribution – Environmental Innovation**

## **PRECISION MANUFACTURING & ETHICAL GEMSTONE PRODUCTION**

## **PRECISION MANUFACTURING & ETHICAL GEMSTONE PRODUCTION**

Our ethical gemstone production model integrates responsible mining, zero-waste processing, and
high-precision finishing — ensuring consistent quality and long-term environmental protection.
Gemrock transforms responsibly sourced Peruvian minerals into high‑quality products for global
markets:
* Hand-selected and carefully quality-graded fine mineral crystal specimens.
* Scratch-free crystal products with perfect shapes and exquisite polish, manufactured by our master
  cutters and according to our elevated standards of color purity and intensity.
* Crystal jewelry, made in-house from sterling silver, gold, or gold-plated silver, that does not
  contain any toxic impurities. The raw material comes from legal sources, not resulting in Amazon
  rainforest destruction.
* A personalized custom cutting service, building on constant feedback between our master cutters
  and our clients.

Through continuous innovation, our ethical gemstone production systems set new industry benchmarks
for quality, sustainability, and transparency.

Ethical gemstone, silver, and gold jewelry production — from raw stone to finished design.

## **BEYOND ETHICAL SOURCING – ENGINEERING A NEW MINERAL ECONOMY**

## **BEYOND ETHICAL SOURCING – ENGINEERING A NEW MINERAL ECONOMY**

At Gemrock International, ethics is not a slogan. It is an operational system.

For nearly a decade, we have built a vertically integrated production model that combines
responsible mining, advanced mineral processing, precision manufacturing, and global logistics — all
under strict environmental and social responsibility principles.

Our production philosophy is based on four engineering pillars:
* Fully integrated mine‑to‑market control
* Fairly paid and healthy jobs
* Zero‑waste material utilization
* Environmental footprint minimization

This approach allows us to deliver consistently high product quality while actively improving
environmental and social conditions across our entire value chain.

[Read more about our ethical mining][183]

## **ENVIRONMENTAL LEADERSHIP & ZERO-WASTE PROCESSING**

### BEYOND SUSTAINABILITY: building regenerative mineral systems.

### BEYOND SUSTAINABILITY: building regenerative mineral systems.

Gemrock International operates one of the most advanced environmental production models in the
global gemstone industry. Our systems are designed not only to minimize damage but to actively
contribute to ecological restoration and climate stability.

### **Our Environmental Framework**

**1. Zero‑Waste Mineral Processing**
Every gram of extracted stone is fully utilized. Premium crystals become jewelry and collector
specimens. Secondary material is transformed into decor and industrial components. Fine residues are
converted into agricultural soil enhancers, pigments, mineral fillers, and construction additives.
No mineral resource is discarded.

**2. Carbon Footprint Reduction & Mineral Carbon Capture**
Optimized logistics, local processing, and mineral carbonation strategies reduce operational CO₂
emissions and permanently bind atmospheric carbon into stable mineral forms.

**3. Water Conservation & Closed‑Loop Systems**
All cutting and grinding processes operate within closed‑loop water systems, drastically reducing
freshwater consumption and eliminating contaminated discharge.

**4. Energy Efficiency & Progressive Electrification**
Production systems are continuously redesigned to minimize energy demand and transition toward
renewable energy integration.

**5. Give‑Back‑to‑Earth Programs**
A defined share of output and revenue is reinvested into species conservation and habitat
regeneration, and environmental research initiatives.

This creates a regenerative mineral cycle — where geological resources actively contribute to
long‑term ecological improvement.

# Ethical Gemstone Production & Global Distribution Network

**From mine to market: zero-waste processing, environmental leadership, and premium gemstone
products from Peru.**

**Mining – Processing – Manufacturing – Global Distribution – Environmental Innovation**

## **PRECISION MANUFACTURING & ETHICAL GEMSTONE PRODUCTION**

## **PRECISION MANUFACTURING & ETHICAL GEMSTONE PRODUCTION**

Our ethical gemstone production model integrates responsible mining, zero-waste processing, and
high-precision finishing — ensuring consistent quality and long-term environmental protection.
Gemrock transforms responsibly sourced Peruvian minerals into high‑quality products for global
markets:
* Hand-selected and carefully quality-graded fine mineral crystal specimens.
* Scratch-free crystal products with perfect shapes and exquisite polish, manufactured by our master
  cutters and according to our elevated standards of color purity and intensity.
* Crystal jewelry, made in-house from sterling silver, gold, or gold-plated silver, that does not
  contain any toxic impurities. The raw material comes from legal sources, not resulting in Amazon
  rainforest destruction.
* A personalized custom cutting service, building on constant feedback between our master cutters
  and our clients.

Through continuous innovation, our ethical gemstone production systems set new industry benchmarks
for quality, sustainability, and transparency.

## **BEYOND ETHICAL SOURCING – ENGINEERING A NEW MINERAL ECONOMY**

## **BEYOND ETHICAL SOURCING – ENGINEERING A NEW MINERAL ECONOMY**

At Gemrock International, ethics is not a slogan. It is an operational system.

For nearly a decade, we have built a vertically integrated production model that combines
responsible mining, advanced mineral processing, precision manufacturing, and global logistics — all
under strict environmental and social responsibility principles.

Our production philosophy is based on four engineering pillars:
* Fully integrated mine‑to‑market control
* Fairly paid and healthy jobs
* Zero‑waste material utilization
* Environmental footprint minimization

This approach allows us to deliver consistently high product quality while actively improving
environmental and social conditions across our entire value chain.

[Read more about our ethical mining][183]

## **ENVIRONMENTAL LEADERSHIP & ZERO-WASTE PROCESSING**

### BEYOND SUSTAINABILITY: building regenerative mineral systems.

### BEYOND SUSTAINABILITY: building regenerative mineral systems.

Gemrock International operates one of the most advanced environmental production models in the
global gemstone industry. Our systems are designed not only to minimize damage but to actively
contribute to ecological restoration and climate stability.

### **Our Environmental Framework**

**1. Zero‑Waste Mineral Processing**
Every gram of extracted stone is fully utilized. Premium crystals become jewelry and collector
specimens. Secondary material is transformed into decor and industrial components. Fine residues are
converted into agricultural soil enhancers, pigments, mineral fillers, and construction additives.
No mineral resource is discarded.

**2. Carbon Footprint Reduction & Mineral Carbon Capture**
Optimized logistics, local processing, and mineral carbonation strategies reduce operational CO₂
emissions and permanently bind atmospheric carbon into stable mineral forms.

**3. Water Conservation & Closed‑Loop Systems**
All cutting and grinding processes operate within closed‑loop water systems, drastically reducing
freshwater consumption and eliminating contaminated discharge.

**4. Energy Efficiency & Progressive Electrification**
Production systems are continuously redesigned to minimize energy demand and transition toward
renewable energy integration.

**5. Give‑Back‑to‑Earth Programs**
A defined share of output and revenue is reinvested into species conservation and habitat
regeneration, and environmental research initiatives.

This creates a regenerative mineral cycle — where geological resources actively contribute to
long‑term ecological improvement.

# Precision Sensors That Power Performance

Smart Solutions. Proven Reliability. Global Impact.

At Gems Sensors & Controls, we don’t just make sensors — we deliver performance. For more than 70
years, engineers and innovators across industries have trusted Gems to power their products, protect
their systems, and keep operations running smoothly. Whether you're building medical devices,
industrial equipment, or next-gen technologies, Gems offers precision-engineered sensors and
controls that give you the edge.

[[Industrial fluid control components including pressure sensors, solenoid valves, level indicators,
and flow switches by Gems Sensors and Warwick Controls]][4]
[Industrial fluid control components including pressure sensors, solenoid valves, level indicators,
and flow switches by Gems Sensors and Warwick Controls]

## Your One-Stop Source for Sensing Solutions

#### From design to delivery, Gems makes it easy to find the perfect sensor for your application —
#### or create one tailored just for you.

[View All Products][5]
[View All Products][6]

## Built for the Real World

#### Every product is built to handle tough environments, tight spaces, and demanding specs — so
#### your systems perform flawlessly, every time.

[View All Industries][7]

## Learn More About Us & Stay Informed

#### Get to know our mission, access technical resources, and stay updated on the latest news and
#### events.

[Rows of illuminated server racks in a modern data center]
[Aerial view of circular water treatment tanks for industrial applications]
[Advanced medical imaging equipment in a hospital operating room]
* Global manufacturing & supply chain
* Custom engineering with fast turnaround
* Responsive service & technical support
* Proven in millions of installations worldwide

# The Gemstone Artist

**Welcome to the home of high-quality custom-cut gems – including natural, untreated gemstones and
certified gems.**

[gemstone artist at work]

**I’m John Bailey, and I provide faceting services for collectors, dealers, miners and museums
around the world. As [featured on the Travel Channel][83], I design and create custom gemstones and
jewelry. Whether you want to purchase a one of a kind piece of fine jewelry or to have an artist
help you design your own engagement ring, I’m here to help.**

**If you want to learn how to facet precious gems, you can follow this link to [Learn Faceting with
John Bailey at the International Faceting Academy][84].**

**If you are a faceter or lapidary artist and want to polish like magic, you can follow this link to
[get some of my own Voodoo Magic Faceting Polish][85]. It’s not a re-labeling of a commercial
product, but something I personally formulated and personally make.**

**Here’s my (former) world record largest flat-faceted flawless red Oregon Sunstone (click the image
for more details):**

[world record oregon sunstone]

**Here’s the kind of thing we do for our clients: This one-minute video shows some of the
progression of cutting a strongly-dichroic Oregon Sunstone – from showing the highly-directional
color – and some views that show how wrong cutting could turn the stone muddy (all the images are
the SAME stone) – to the pure and rich green that precise orientation and cutting can produce.**

**Working directly with the artist offers special rewards, especially when you want to:**
* **Design an engagement ring**
* **Create a special valentine gift for him**
* **Commission a unique gift for her**
* **Discover birthstone jewelry using custom-cut birth stones**
* **Imagine the perfect prom jewelry or prom gift**
* **Purchase an affordable engagement ring – custom made to perfectly fit both your feelings and
  your wallet.**

**I am well-known for my original designs, and can custom design a new cut for your special person
or occasion. I also mine much of my own material, and of work directly with the miners of Sapphire
and other fine gems, allowing me to offer certified natural treasures.**

  by shape, search for gems by color, and buy gemstones by type.**

# The Gemstone Artist

**Welcome to the home of high-quality custom-cut gems – including natural, untreated gemstones and
certified gems.**

[gemstone artist at work]

**I’m John Bailey, and I provide faceting services for collectors, dealers, miners and museums
around the world. As [featured on the Travel Channel][83], I design and create custom gemstones and
jewelry. Whether you want to purchase a one of a kind piece of fine jewelry or to have an artist
help you design your own engagement ring, I’m here to help.**

**If you want to learn how to facet precious gems, you can follow this link to [Learn Faceting with
John Bailey at the International Faceting Academy][84].**

**If you are a faceter or lapidary artist and want to polish like magic, you can follow this link to
[get some of my own Voodoo Magic Faceting Polish][85]. It’s not a re-labeling of a commercial
product, but something I personally formulated and personally make.**

for more details):**

[world record oregon sunstone]

progression of cutting a strongly-dichroic Oregon Sunstone – from showing the highly-directional
color – and some views that show how wrong cutting could turn the stone muddy (all the images are
the SAME stone) – to the pure and rich green that precise orientation and cutting can produce.**

**Working directly with the artist offers special rewards, especially when you want to:**
* **Design an engagement ring**
* **Create a special valentine gift for him**
* **Commission a unique gift for her**
* **Discover birthstone jewelry using custom-cut birth stones**
* **Imagine the perfect prom jewelry or prom gift**
* **Purchase an affordable engagement ring – custom made to perfectly fit both your feelings and
  your wallet.**

**I am well-known for my original designs, and can custom design a new cut for your special person
or occasion. I also mine much of my own material, and of work directly with the miners of Sapphire
and other fine gems, allowing me to offer certified natural treasures.**

#### Frequently asked questions

How do I place an order online?

Go to the Products page, select the product(s) you want, and click "Add to Cart", then enter the
quantity. When you are ready, click "Place Order". We will receive your order details, calculate
shipping for your destination, and send you a notification with the updated order. You can track all
details under My Orders.

What payment methods do you accept?

We accept payment by bank transfer (including Telex Transfer (T/T) or wire transfer) and PayPal.

Where do your stones come from?

Most of our gemstones are sourced directly from mines in India. We also offer a selection of stones
from Brazil, Afghanistan, Africa, and other regions, depending on availability and our quality
standards.

How long will it take to receive my order?

If the items are in stock, we will ship your order within 5–7 days of order confirmation. If the
items are not in stock, delivery time will depend on the quantity ordered, and we will inform you of
the estimated shipping date in advance. Once shipped, the courier typically takes 5–7 business days
to deliver.

How much does shipping cost?

Shipping cost depends on the total weight of your order. We will provide the exact shipping cost
after reviewing your order details.

# [The Why Of The Cut][22]

Posted on [June 29, 2015][23] by [erma][24]

#### Gemstone Cuts and The Why.

Who does the cutting? What are the different methods of cutting? Ever thought why it is cut that
way?
What is a cabochon?  Why a Marquise?  isn’t that a Royal title such as Baron or Earl? ( Actually it
is a royal title that is lower than a Duke but higher than an Earl, if you are into Royalty.)

After delving into the history of gemstone cutting I have found some interesting answers.
A gem cutter is called a “Lapidarist” This trade is usually learned on the job, but there are
several colleges that do give courses.  How long it takes to learn, depends on the skill of the
student.

#### The different methods of cutting are tumbling, cabbing, faceting and carving.

**Tumbling**, the simplest method, is done in a revolving barrel with abrasives. Finer and finer
abrasives are used until the stones have the expected high sheen. This is closest to nature as the
same thing happens to stones in a stream. Of course, man made tumbling creates a much higher polish.

[[Rock Tumbler]][25]

Rock Tumbler

**Cabbing** is the cutting of cabochons, the most common form of gem cutting.
Cabochons are cut with a highly polished rounded or convex top, no faceting,and a flat or slightly
domed base. This cut is used for softer stones to safeguard them from scratching. It is also the
main cut for opals, turquoise,onyx, moonstone and star sapphire. Cabochons are not actually cut but
shaped and polished. they are much easier to produce than faceted stones witch have many angles.
They can be produced in any shape but oval is the most used.

This cut is used for star saphires and tiger’s eye stones to get the most of the design and
brilliance.

**The faceted cut** can be various shapes, where as the cabochon has special limits.
Facet is the cut but not the shape.  It is actually the shaping of many cuts to show the stone at
it’s best color and shine.

All natural stones including the rocks you might find along the edge of the road, have prisms or 
points of light that enhance their color. ( You might want to study an old rock just for the fun of
it.) Faceting was created to take advantage of that fact.

There are simple faceted cuts such as these step cornered aquamarine gems from the Smithsonian gem
gallery or the many faceted cuts shown here in this round brilliant cut.

[[Step Cut Gemstones]][26]

Step Cut Gemstones

[[Round Brilliant Cut]][27]

Round Brilliant Cut

This started in the 13th and 14th centuries. At a time when stone cutting machines   were being
invented to actually do the job. Before then, one would have to hire an artist to actually carve out
a stone by hand, which could take many, many hours. Today there are very few lapidary carvers. One
design that has been carved through the ages is the Cameo, which is usually cut from sea shells or
agate.

 

**The Marquise Cut**
The marquise cut is a thin oblong shape with pointed ends and is named after Jean Antoinette
Poisson, the Marquise de Pompadour……….. It is said French King, Louis the IV, asked his jewelers to
create a cut to capture his mistress’ smile

Madame Pompadour

… For that interesting story go here..[http://www.ajsgem.com/articles/history-marquise-cut.html][29]

**A marquise has 57 facets.**

 

[[Marquise Cut]][30]

Marquise Cut

**The Princess Cut**
Then there is the Princess cut which is a square version of the round brilliant. **It has 76
