# [The Atlantis Stone][41]

Posted on [May 19, 2015][42] by [erma][43]

### The Atlantis Stone

Recently I was introduced to the “newest” gemstone. A beautiful blue stone I had never seen before.
Well it wasn’t new of course, no gemstone is new. The latest gemstone to be found in modern times by
modern geologists is “Larimar” the ” Atlantis stone”, also known as the “Dolphin Stone”. It is only
found in the Caribbean, natives have been using this stone down through the ages for healing,
divination and decoration.

[[ Larimar stones]][44]

Larimar stones

It was first discovered by modern man in 1916, Father Loren of the Barahona Parish in the Dominican
Republic requested permission to mine a certain blue rock he had discovered. His request was
rejected because “pectolites” were not known in that end of the world.

Larimar is a pectolite which is composed mostly of acid silicate hydrate of calcium and sodium.
Pectolite is found in many locations but no others have the distinct blue color of Larimar. That is
a result of a copper substitution for calcium in this unique stone.

Next in 1974, Dominican Republic geologist Miquel Mendez rediscovered the stone, naming it after his
daughter Larissa. He used the Spanish word for sea “mar”and formed Larimar. The stones he and his
partner Norman Rilling found, had been washed into the sea by the Bahoruco River. When they searched
up river they soon found the stones source and the Los Chapaderos mine was created.

[[Larimar]][45]

Larimar

The stone did not reach the USA until 1986 and is still fairly rare in gemstone listings.

### Healing Qualities

Larimar is said to support and promote emotional strength, releasing stress and cooling tempers. It
is also an antidote for hot flashes. Used in meditation it helps one release unhealthy bonds to
negative people who do not hold your best interests. When placed throughout your home it creates a
pleasant, quiet atmosphere.

In healing it is used for the throat, also to reduce fevers and draw out inflammation. When placed
on a painful area it provides soothing relief. It stimulates the heart and higher chakras. A stone
of love.

Larimar is called the Atlantis stone due to a declaration by an ancient prophet that Atlantis was
once part of the Dominican Republic and what made Atlantis great was a beautiful, blue healing
stone. The description of that stone has an uncanny resemblance to Larimar.

After seeing this stone for the first time I can believe it. I have never seen a more beautiful
blue.

[[Polished Larimar]][46]

Polished Larimar

#### An interesting note about “Atlantis”  the lost continent.

Edgar Cayce, (March 18,1877 – January 3,1945)  One of the greatest clairvoyants the world has ever
seen, predicted    that a “blue stone” with extraordinary healing attributes would be found on “an
island in the Caribbean” where he believed part of Atlantis could be found. In 1974 a volcanic blue
pectolite named Larimar was discovered in the Dominican Republic.  Read more about healing crystals
and Atlantis [here.][47]

 

Resources; “The Pocket Book Of Stones” Robert Simmons
“The Illustrated Directory of Healing Crystals” by Cassandra Eason
http://www.bernardine.com/gemstones/larimar.htm
http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Larimar

 

Until next time,

Have a great day!

Erma.

# [Garnet – A Gem For All Seasons][57]

Posted on [March 10, 2015][58] by [erma][59]

### The Many Facets of  Garnets

I have always loved garnets. Once thought “if I can’t have a ruby I’ll have a garnet.” At that time
I did not know the different qualities and varieties of gemstones. Now I find I can have both. There
are many price brackets in all the gems. In other words something for everyone. Also some garnets
are just as expensive as the beautiful ruby.

The other thing I did not know was how many colors of garnets there are. Most of us think of the
garnet as dark red or purple, but there are green, orange, red, purple, even black. It was once
thought there was no blue garnets until someone found color changing garnets from Madagasgar. They
change from grey blue to cornflower blue depending on the light and where they are found.. All are
beautiful. Each color has a slightly different chemical makeup and are classed as species.

[[many colors of garnets]][60]

many colors of garnets

#### Garnets have more species than any other gemstone,The six main ones are:

Almandine
Pyrope
Spessartite
Grossular
Andradite
Uvarovite

All six have varying color ranges from light rose red to black. The andraite being the rarest with
colors ranging from a lustrous rose to the very rare black malanite.
– See more at: [http://www.minerals.net/gemstone/garnet_gemstone.aspx#sthash.iX6GeqHl.dpuf][61]

It is also one of the very few gemstones hardly ever enhanced so you are getting natural purity.

The garnet is very important to geologists due to it’s chemical and magnetic properties. With each

#### Gemstone Cuts and The Why.

Who does the cutting? What are the different methods of cutting? Ever thought why it is cut that

What is a cabochon?  Why a Marquise?  isn’t that a Royal title such as Baron or Earl? ( Actually it
is a royal title that is lower than a Duke but higher than an Earl, if you are into Royalty.)

domed base. This cut is used for softer stones to safeguard them from scratching. It is also the
main cut for opals, turquoise,onyx, moonstone and star sapphire. Cabochons are not actually cut but
shaped and polished. they are much easier to produce than faceted stones witch have many angles.
They can be produced in any shape but oval is the most used.

This cut is used for star saphires and tiger’s eye stones to get the most of the design and
brilliance.

# [The Atlantis Stone][41]

Posted on [May 19, 2015][42] by [erma][43]

### The Atlantis Stone

Recently I was introduced to the “newest” gemstone. A beautiful blue stone I had never seen before.
Well it wasn’t new of course, no gemstone is new. The latest gemstone to be found in modern times by
modern geologists is “Larimar” the ” Atlantis stone”, also known as the “Dolphin Stone”. It is only
found in the Caribbean, natives have been using this stone down through the ages for healing,
divination and decoration.

[[ Larimar stones]][44]

Larimar stones

It was first discovered by modern man in 1916, Father Loren of the Barahona Parish in the Dominican
Republic requested permission to mine a certain blue rock he had discovered. His request was
rejected because “pectolites” were not known in that end of the world.

Larimar is a pectolite which is composed mostly of acid silicate hydrate of calcium and sodium.
Pectolite is found in many locations but no others have the distinct blue color of Larimar. That is
a result of a copper substitution for calcium in this unique stone.

Next in 1974, Dominican Republic geologist Miquel Mendez rediscovered the stone, naming it after his
daughter Larissa. He used the Spanish word for sea “mar”and formed Larimar. The stones he and his
partner Norman Rilling found, had been washed into the sea by the Bahoruco River. When they searched
up river they soon found the stones source and the Los Chapaderos mine was created.

[[Larimar]][45]

Larimar

The stone did not reach the USA until 1986 and is still fairly rare in gemstone listings.

### Healing Qualities

Larimar is said to support and promote emotional strength, releasing stress and cooling tempers. It
is also an antidote for hot flashes. Used in meditation it helps one release unhealthy bonds to
negative people who do not hold your best interests. When placed throughout your home it creates a
pleasant, quiet atmosphere.

In healing it is used for the throat, also to reduce fevers and draw out inflammation. When placed
on a painful area it provides soothing relief. It stimulates the heart and higher chakras. A stone
of love.

Larimar is called the Atlantis stone due to a declaration by an ancient prophet that Atlantis was
once part of the Dominican Republic and what made Atlantis great was a beautiful, blue healing
stone. The description of that stone has an uncanny resemblance to Larimar.

After seeing this stone for the first time I can believe it. I have never seen a more beautiful
blue.

[[Polished Larimar]][46]

Polished Larimar

#### An interesting note about “Atlantis”  the lost continent.

Edgar Cayce, (March 18,1877 – January 3,1945)  One of the greatest clairvoyants the world has ever
seen, predicted    that a “blue stone” with extraordinary healing attributes would be found on “an
island in the Caribbean” where he believed part of Atlantis could be found. In 1974 a volcanic blue
pectolite named Larimar was discovered in the Dominican Republic.  Read more about healing crystals
and Atlantis [here.][47]

 

Resources; “The Pocket Book Of Stones” Robert Simmons
“The Illustrated Directory of Healing Crystals” by Cassandra Eason
http://www.bernardine.com/gemstones/larimar.htm
http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Larimar

 

Until next time,

Have a great day!

Erma.

# [Garnet – A Gem For All Seasons][57]

Posted on [March 10, 2015][58] by [erma][59]

### The Many Facets of  Garnets

I have always loved garnets. Once thought “if I can’t have a ruby I’ll have a garnet.” At that time
I did not know the different qualities and varieties of gemstones. Now I find I can have both. There
are many price brackets in all the gems. In other words something for everyone. Also some garnets
are just as expensive as the beautiful ruby.

The other thing I did not know was how many colors of garnets there are. Most of us think of the
garnet as dark red or purple, but there are green, orange, red, purple, even black. It was once
thought there was no blue garnets until someone found color changing garnets from Madagasgar. They
change from grey blue to cornflower blue depending on the light and where they are found.. All are
beautiful. Each color has a slightly different chemical makeup and are classed as species.

[[many colors of garnets]][60]

many colors of garnets

#### Garnets have more species than any other gemstone,The six main ones are:

Almandine
Pyrope
Spessartite
Grossular
Andradite
Uvarovite

All six have varying color ranges from light rose red to black. The andraite being the rarest with
colors ranging from a lustrous rose to the very rare black malanite.
– See more at: [http://www.minerals.net/gemstone/garnet_gemstone.aspx#sthash.iX6GeqHl.dpuf][61]

  We are committed to sending your rental payout to you within 48 hours of the tenant’s payment

  by us by the 10th of the month, in general.

### scalable… grows as your business expands

### robust… to handle 24×7 mission critical applications

### flexible… to keep up with your changing requirements

### powerful… using Smalltalk, a highly productive development environment

### proven… in production use for decades by Fortune 500 companies


GemStone/S™ is an advanced platform for developing, deploying, and managing scalable,
high-performance, multi-tier applications based on business objects. GemStone/S provides the
unmatched flexibility and power demanded by business-critical applications.

## The GemStone/S product family includes:

───────────────────────────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────────────────────────────
[**GemBuilder® for Java**][72]                 │[**GemStone/S**][75]                                
[**GemConnect®**][73]                          │[**GemBuilder for Smalltalk/VW**][76]               
[**Visual Stat Display (VSD)**][74]            │[**GemBuilder for Smalltalk/VA**][77]               
───────────────────────────────────────────────┴────────────────────────────────────────────────────

### Building high-performance applications is more than acquiring software.

To make the best use of GemStone products, GemTalk Systems provides world-class technical support,
consulting, training, and staff augmentation. Our Engineering Team works together to provide these
services, focusing on providing the very highest quality of integrated products and technical
services for our customers.

[

## Support

][78]
** GemTalk’s Technical Support** is dedicated to the success of our customers, taking whatever time
and effort is needed to understand, solve, and explain technical problems and questions.
[Learn More][79]

][80]
**Staff Augmentation** allows you ongoing remote assistance in leveraging your domain skills with
GemStone expertise.

code review and feature development, through performance tuning, and even temporary staffing for
specific GemStone projects. GemTalk consultants have unparalleled ability to help you get the most
out of your GemStone system.

### [Four Seasons Resort Maui at Wailea Introduces Kai Holo Spa, A Wellness Sanctuary Inspired by
### the Flow of the Island][97]

Hawaii's five-star, five-diamond Four Seasons Resort Maui at Wailea unveils Kai Holo Spa, a wellness
destination where island-inspired experiences meet modern innovation. Translating to "flowing tide"
in Hawaiian, Kai Holo Spa invites guests into a personal flow state, where they move seamlessly
through an immersive aquathermal experience, island-inspired Pacific Journeys, and cutting-edge
offerings. Every aspect has been designed to restore and transform.

## Built for modern jewelry owners in San Diego.

When someone searches for jewelry appraisal San Diego, they are usually carrying a story: an
engagement ring that needs insurance, a family piece that needs estate jewelry appraisal
documentation, a diamond that needs a professional opinion, a watch that needs authentication, or a
designer item that needs clarity before resale.

JAGI Lab turns that moment into a polished experience. Public customers can start appraisal orders
online and move through the process with confidence. Trade and wholesale clients keep the
professional structure they already rely on, including account-based pricing and repeat appraisal
workflows.

As a San Diego appraisal lab, JAGI can speak to both worlds: the emotional world of jewelry
ownership and the operational world of professional appraisal documentation. The result is
luxury-level presentation backed by practical systems.

Services include CardCert Jewelry Appraisal, Full Jewelry Appraisal, Designer Authentication,
Designer Authentication Full Appraisal, Watch ID Card, Watch Authentication, Gemstone ID, Diamond
Melee Sorting, Gemstone Sorting, GIA Concierge Service, repair support, and Web Photos/Video.

[San Diego gemologist performing appraisal work]
FAQ

## Answers that help customers say yes.

What kind of jewelry appraisal services does JAGI offer?

JAGI offers CardCert Jewelry Appraisal, Full Jewelry Appraisal, professional jewelry appraisal,
insurance jewelry appraisal, estate jewelry appraisal, and diamond appraisal San Diego services.

Can I start an order online?

Yes. Public customers can start an online appraisal order. Trade, wholesale, affiliate, and
account-based clients can use the same platform with pricing and workflow logic suited to their
category.

Is JAGI only for wholesale clients?

No. JAGI serves both public customers and trade clients. The online order platform is for both
groups.

Do you offer jewelry authentication San Diego services?

Yes. JAGI supports designer jewelry authentication, Designer Authentication Full Appraisal, watch
authentication, Watch ID Card service, gemstone identification, and related documentation.

Can certificates be searched online?

Yes. Customers and professionals can use the certificate search path to locate searchable
certificates and organized appraisal documentation.

Do you help with repair or presentation services?

Yes. Services include Jewelry Cleaning, Polish & Clean, Refurbishing, Rhodium Plating, Prong Repair,
Soldering, Mounting/Unmounting Stones, and Web Photos/Video.

## Journey Through Generations

The story of KGK Group began when Shri Keshrimalji Kothari embarked on a journey to Burma, trading
gemstones in India. His dedication and integrity set the foundation for a global presence. Shri
Ghisilalji Kothari expanded the vision, fostering innovation and excellence.

Today, under Mr. Navrattan Kothari, KGK Group has become a premium global brand, with Mr. Sanjay and
Mr. Sandeep Kothari continuing the legacy and the fifth generation, including Mr. Saransh, Mr.
Vedant, and Mr. Arnav, shaping the future.

[DISCOVER MORE][12]

## Businesses

KGK Group stands out with its vertically integrated business model, seamlessly connecting the entire
value chain from mines to retail. As a global leader in diamonds and gemstones, KGK Group provides
exceptional quality to customers worldwide.

KGK Group leads with a vertically integrated model, connecting the entire value

chain from mines to retail, delivering exceptional quality globally.

[JEWELLERY]

### JEWELLERY

Timeless elegance meets craftsmanship. KGK jewellery blends innovation with style and
sophistication.

## Journey Through Generations

The story of KGK Group began when Shri Keshrimalji Kothari embarked on a journey to Burma, trading
gemstones in India. His dedication and integrity set the foundation for a global presence. Shri
Ghisilalji Kothari expanded the vision, fostering innovation and excellence.

Today, under Mr. Navrattan Kothari, KGK Group has become a premium global brand, with Mr. Sanjay and
Mr. Sandeep Kothari continuing the legacy and the fifth generation, including Mr. Saransh, Mr.
Vedant, and Mr. Arnav, shaping the future.

[DISCOVER MORE][12]

## Businesses

KGK Group stands out with its vertically integrated business model, seamlessly connecting the entire
value chain from mines to retail. As a global leader in diamonds and gemstones, KGK Group provides
exceptional quality to customers worldwide.

KGK Group leads with a vertically integrated model, connecting the entire value

chain from mines to retail, delivering exceptional quality globally.

**The Art and Luxury Behind Jewelry**

# Brilliant Life

### **MOQ**

Different types of gemstones have different minimum order quantities. So you can order exactly what
you need without overinvesting. We also offer custom gold jewelry, either as a single piece or as a
complete set.

### **Gemstone**

At Qinfa Jewelry,Customization is at the core of what we do. We offer a wide range of natural
semi-precious stones and synthetic gemstones, including glass and zircon, to suit your unique needs.

### **Jewelry** Plating Option

Qinfa Jewelry fine jewelry manufacturer provides different materials custom jewelry options, such as
elegance of gold, the versatility of sterling silver & brass, or the modern allure of stainless
steel and so on.

***A Quick Look at Our [Qinfa Jewelry Factory][14]*
**

## qinfa jewelry

As a leading gemstone manufacturer, we proudly craft exceptional gemstones that meet the highest
standards of beauty and precision. By combining advanced technology with skilled craftsmanship and a
deep understanding of each stone’s natural properties, we consistently deliver products that are
both visually stunning and intrinsically valuable.

From sourcing and cutting gemstones to customization and final quality checks, we oversee every
stage with unwavering attention to detail. Moreover, whether you’re looking for one-of-a-kind custom
designs or large-scale production, we provide flexible, scalable solutions tailored to your brand’s
vision and evolving market demands.

Partnered with brands around the globe, we continue to push the boundaries of innovation while
upholding our core commitment to quality and artistry. Each gemstone we create reflects timeless
brilliance and expert care.

So why wait? Choose us—and together, we’ll bring your jewelry vision to life, illuminating the world
with beauty, one extraordinary piece at a time.

**Our Jewelry**

## Jewelry Theme

### Bamboo Leaf Bracelet Ring

This bamboo leaf bracelet ring combines natural inspiration with exquisite craftsmanship, showing a
unique elegance and fresh temperament

### Elegant zircon necklace

This elegant zircon necklace exudes captivating radiance, perfectly embodying the fusion of
sophistication and luxury.

### Vintage amber ring

This vintage amber ring showcases warm amber hues, unique texture and radiance, creating a perfect
blend of classic and modern design.

**CONTACT US**

## CNC cutting releases the purest brilliance of gemstones.

Whether it is complex shapes, unique designs, or standardized mass production, we can achieve it
efficiently, meet the personalized needs of different customers, and help create unique works.

## Gemstone Rough Sourcing

Our gemstones are sourced through a responsible and transparent procurement process from trusted
mines, suppliers, and trading partners. We prioritise ethical sourcing practices, ensuring
compliance with applicable regulations, traceability standards, and sustainable business principles.

## Rough Selection & Sorting

After sourcing, gemstones are carefully sorted based on color, clarity, size, shape, quality,
inclusions, and transparency. Each stone is assessed for its cutting potential and categorized
accordingly, ensuring efficient processing and consistent quality throughout the manufacturing
process. Low-quality gemstones are separated from premium-grade material.

## Cutting & Shaping

Selected rough gemstones are carefully cut and shaped by skilled artisans to maximize their natural
beauty and value. Each stone is processed with precision to achieve the desired shape, symmetry, and
proportions while preserving its quality and enhancing its potential for brilliance.

## Facets & Polished

Following the cutting and shaping process, gemstones are expertly faceted to enhance their
brilliance and light reflection, with careful attention to symmetry and proportions. They are then
polished to achieve a smooth, high-lustre finish, revealing their natural beauty and ensuring a
premium-quality appearance.

## Quality Check

Upon completion of the cutting, faceting, and polishing stages, every gemstone undergoes a thorough
quality check to verify dimensions, shape, polish, symmetry, color, clarity, and overall finish.
Each stone is inspected against strict quality standards to ensure consistency, accuracy, and
excellence before it is approved for shipment and final packing.

## Secure Packing

Approved gemstones are securely packed using protective materials, including pouches, bubble wrap,
and boxes, to safeguard their quality during transit. Each shipment is carefully labelled, verified,
and prepared according to established packing standards, ensuring safe and reliable delivery to
customers worldwide.

## Ship with Trusted Delivery Partners

Gemstones are securely packed, labeled, and verified before shipment. We work with trusted delivery
partners to ensure safe, timely, and reliable transportation, allowing each order to reach its
destination in perfect condition. Products are shipped worldwide through secure courier services
like UPS Fedex with required documentation.

## Gemstone Rough Sourcing

Our gemstones are sourced through a responsible and transparent procurement process from trusted
mines, suppliers, and trading partners. We prioritise ethical sourcing practices, ensuring
compliance with applicable regulations, traceability standards, and sustainable business principles.

## Rough Selection & Sorting

After sourcing, gemstones are carefully sorted based on color, clarity, size, shape, quality,
inclusions, and transparency. Each stone is assessed for its cutting potential and categorized
accordingly, ensuring efficient processing and consistent quality throughout the manufacturing
process. Low-quality gemstones are separated from premium-grade material.

## Cutting & Shaping

Selected rough gemstones are carefully cut and shaped by skilled artisans to maximize their natural
beauty and value. Each stone is processed with precision to achieve the desired shape, symmetry, and
proportions while preserving its quality and enhancing its potential for brilliance.

## Facets & Polished

Following the cutting and shaping process, gemstones are expertly faceted to enhance their
brilliance and light reflection, with careful attention to symmetry and proportions. They are then
polished to achieve a smooth, high-lustre finish, revealing their natural beauty and ensuring a
premium-quality appearance.

## Quality Check

Upon completion of the cutting, faceting, and polishing stages, every gemstone undergoes a thorough
quality check to verify dimensions, shape, polish, symmetry, color, clarity, and overall finish.
Each stone is inspected against strict quality standards to ensure consistency, accuracy, and
excellence before it is approved for shipment and final packing.

## Secure Packing

Approved gemstones are securely packed using protective materials, including pouches, bubble wrap,
and boxes, to safeguard their quality during transit. Each shipment is carefully labelled, verified,
and prepared according to established packing standards, ensuring safe and reliable delivery to
customers worldwide.

## Ship with Trusted Delivery Partners

Gemstones are securely packed, labeled, and verified before shipment. We work with trusted delivery
partners to ensure safe, timely, and reliable transportation, allowing each order to reach its
destination in perfect condition. Products are shipped worldwide through secure courier services
like UPS Fedex with required documentation.

# Trusted Jewelry Appraisers in Baltimore, MD, Serving the Surrounding Areas

Welcome to Danielle Broussard Jewelry Appraisals, where precision, trust, and expertise define every
service we offer. I’m Danielle Broussard, a certified jewelry appraiser proudly serving Baltimore,
MD, and the surrounding areas. With credentials from AJP and NAJA, along with specialized training
from GIA, I provide professional jewelry appraisals tailored to your needs.

Whether you require a jewelry insurance appraisal to protect your valuable pieces, an estate jewelry
appraisal to assess inherited items, or a jewelry consultation before making an important purchase,
I am here to help. Understanding the true worth of your jewelry appraisers is essential for
insurance coverage, resale, or estate planning, and I ensure that every appraisal is conducted with
precision and care.

My gemological services go beyond standard appraisals. If you’re considering selling a cherished
piece, my jewelry-buying consultation can help you navigate the process confidently. I provide
detailed assessments so you can make informed decisions about your collection.

As a jewelry expert, I specialize in evaluating diamonds, gemstones, antique jewelry, and modern
designs, ensuring that each appraisal reflects the true market value. Whether you are looking to
authenticate a recent purchase or determine the fair market price for an estate sale, I take pride
in delivering transparent and accurate valuations.

Let me guide you through the often-complex world of jewelry with professionalism and dedication so
you can feel secure in your investment.

## Piaget watches and jewelry: a legacy of excellence and mastery

Piaget is a renowned swiss watchmaker and jeweler well known for crafting exquisite timepieces and
jewelry since 1874. Creations are a testament to Piaget dedication to craftmanship, using gold to
create timeless pieces. Piaget has been crafting watches and jewelry by blending a jeweler’s
refinement with its watchmaking sophistication.
The Maison's commitment to excellence is reflected in their Ateliers de l'Extraordinaire, where
master artisans continue to harness rare skills, transforming gold, stones, and precious gems into
dazzling pieces of art. Piaget's legacy is built on innovation, evident in their ultra-thin watch
movements, which became the Maison's trademark. From the intricate details of their watches to the
elegant designs of their jewelry, Piaget embodies mastery and flamboyance. Whether you seek
sophisticated or elegant design, Piaget offers a wide range of creations that truly express it.
Piaget's daring creativity is evident in their collections, including Piaget Polo, Possession,
Altiplano, Limelight Gala, Piaget Rose, Piaget Sunlight.

## Piaget watches and jewelry: a legacy of excellence and mastery

Piaget is a renowned swiss watchmaker and jeweler well known for crafting exquisite timepieces and
jewelry since 1874. Creations are a testament to Piaget dedication to craftmanship, using gold to
create timeless pieces. Piaget has been crafting watches and jewelry by blending a jeweler’s
refinement with its watchmaking sophistication.
The Maison's commitment to excellence is reflected in their Ateliers de l'Extraordinaire, where
master artisans continue to harness rare skills, transforming gold, stones, and precious gems into
dazzling pieces of art. Piaget's legacy is built on innovation, evident in their ultra-thin watch
movements, which became the Maison's trademark. From the intricate details of their watches to the
elegant designs of their jewelry, Piaget embodies mastery and flamboyance. Whether you seek
sophisticated or elegant design, Piaget offers a wide range of creations that truly express it.
Piaget's daring creativity is evident in their collections, including Piaget Polo, Possession,
Altiplano, Limelight Gala, Piaget Rose, Piaget Sunlight.

### Zultanite®

**Naturally Precious**. Zultanite® is a rare and recently discovered color changing gemstone. The
only mine is the world is located in south-western Turkey. Provenance Gems is the official
distributor to the US, Caribbean and Cruise Ship Duty Free Retail.

[ EXPLORE ][44]

[34_3191b_1sqs_-_template_slider_w_87s7.jpg]

### Cuervo y Sobrinos

**Swiss Manufacture, Latin Heritage**. Founded in 1882 in Havana, today each and every Cuervo y
Sobrinos watch is made in Lugano, Switzerland. Provenance Gems is the official distributor to the
US, Caribbean and Cruise Ship Duty Free retail.

[ EXPLORE ][45]
View fullsize
[CAPITOLIO+JEWELRY+LOGO.jpg]

### Capitolio™

**Born in Havana - 100% Miami**. Capitolio™ is a range of fine jewelry that takes inspiration from
the history of these special cities. Each and every Capitolio™ creation is made in Miami. The latest
collection is inspired by Miami’s Freedom Tower.

[ EXPLORE ][46]

to demand and market. We try to supply the best quality we can and I am sure you won’t be

Ruby

True rarity lies in natural color and internal harmony — not intensity.

Tanzanite

Pleochroism and depth define the stone’s character — a rare balance shaped by a single origin.

The 2026 BIO International Convention, held June 22-25, 2026 at the San Diego Convention Center,
marked a pivotal moment for the biotechnology industry. With nearly 20,000 attendees from over 76
countries (43% international), the event showcased a resurgent biotech sector characterized by
record-breaking deal activity, accelerated AI adoption, and renewed investor confidence. The
convention's theme, "Driven by Purpose," underscored the industry's commitment to transforming
scientific breakthroughs into life-changing therapies. Notable highlights included a landmark $2.5
billion AI-powered drug discovery collaboration, over $100 billion in M&A activity, approximately
70,000 partnering meetings, and transformative regulatory updates from the FDA and EMA.

### [EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][20]

Abstract: EHA-7202 Short: LB5009 The question of whether post-transplant cyclophosphamide (PTCy)
should replace anti-thymocyte globulin (ATG/ATLG) as the standard GVHD prophylaxis backbone in
HLA-compatible 10/10 matched unrelated donor (MUD) hematopoietic cell transplantation (HCT) has now
been directly addressed by a large, prospective randomized controlled trial presented at EHA 2026 by
Prof. Johannes Schetelig (Dresden, Germany) and co-investigators including Matthias Stelljes. The
trial — designated the GRAPPA study — concludes that ATG-based prophylaxis retains its
standard-of-care position in this specific setting, with PTCy failing to demonstrate superiority on
the primary composite endpoint. This finding is contextualized against a backdrop of registry data,
meta-analyses, and prior Phase 2/3 evidence that had generated significant debate about PTCy's
potential to displace ATG in the 10/10 MUD context.

been directly addressed by a large, prospective randomized controlled trial presented at EHA 2026 by
Prof. Johannes Schetelig (Dresden, Germany) and co-investigators including Matthias Stelljes. The
trial — designated the GRAPPA study — concludes that ATG-based prophylaxis retains its
standard-of-care position in this specific setting, with PTCy failing to demonstrate superiority on
the primary composite endpoint. This finding is contextualized against a backdrop of registry data,
meta-analyses, and prior Phase 2/3 evidence that had generated significant debate about PTCy's
potential to displace ATG in the 10/10 MUD context.

### Welcome to

## The Gem Expo
## Your Destination for Crystals, Gemstones, Beads, Minerals & Handmade Jewellery

If you’re passionate about precious stones, crystals, gemstones, minerals, or artisan jewellery,
**TheGemExpo.com** is your go-to destination. From ethically sourced crystals, rare mineral
specimens, and rare gemstones to handcrafted gemstone jewellery, The Gem Expo show offers a curated
collection that brings the magic of the earth to your fingertips.

**Discover Unique Crystals and Gemstones from Canada and Around the World**

At The Gem Expo, we showcase a wide range of natural crystals, semi-precious stones, and minerals
sourced from Canada and across the globe. You’ll find stunning pieces from:
* Canada’s mineral-rich regions, including Ontario, Alberta, and British Columbia
* Brazil’s amethyst and quartz mines
* Madagascar’s vibrant labradorite and ocean jasper
* India’s healing stones, like moonstone, apophyllite, and black tourmaline
* Morocco’s desert geodes, vanadinite clusters, and selenite products

Whether you’re looking for polished points, raw stones, geodes, beads, or rare collector specimens.
Explore our collection to learn about different gemstone names and discover your favorites, from
beginner to expert.

#### Choose where you want to purchase your tickets from:

[ Universe Ticket ][38]
[ Eventbrite Ticket ][39]

Handcrafted** Gemstone Jewellery by Artisan Designers**

TheGemExpo.com is also home to a diverse range of handmade gemstone jewellery crafted by local and
international artisans. Each piece is thoughtfully crafted using genuine stones and sterling silver,
making them perfect for gift-giving, spiritual work, or personal style.
* Sterling silver gemstone rings, bracelets, earrings, and pendants with real gemstones
* Gem rings featuring aquamarine stone, tourmaline stone, and other precious varieties
* Birthstone jewellery personalized for every month
* Chakra bracelets and energy-clearing tools
* One-of-a-kind statement pieces you won’t find anywhere else

**A Trusted Name in the Rock and Gem Show & Mineral Community**

The Gem Expo gem show Toronto is the largest mineral and gem show, and is held three times a year.
The show brings together many trusted vendors, artists, and collectors.
* Authentic crystals, minerals, and jewellery from verified vendors
* Items curated by passionate collectors and gemologists
* New inventory with new stones and metaphysical tools is brought in every show
* Support small Canadian businesses and independent artisans with every purchase

**Start Exploring Today**

From healing crystals and chakra stones to beautifully crafted gemstone jewellery, from raw minerals
to beads, The Gem Expo is your trusted source for earth’s natural treasures.

Join thousands of collectors, crystal healers, and jewellery lovers who believe in the beauty,
energy, and story behind every stone.

**Sri Lanka Pavilion – Special for the November 27-29 Expo**

At the request of Raytronics Lanka Pvt Ltd (Sri Lanka) and International ASEAN Corporation Inc.
(Canada), The Gem Expo has designated a dedicated Sri Lanka Pavilion within the exhibition. This
special section will showcase and promote Sri Lankan gemstones, fine jewellery, investment
opportunities, Ceylon spices, and other value-added Sri Lankan products and services. The initiative
is intended to strengthen trade, investment, and business partnerships between Sri Lanka and Canada
while highlighting the quality, heritage, and global competitiveness of Sri Lankan industries.

### Welcome to

## The Gem Expo
## Your Destination for Crystals, Gemstones, Beads, Minerals & Handmade Jewellery

If you’re passionate about precious stones, crystals, gemstones, minerals, or artisan jewellery,
**TheGemExpo.com** is your go-to destination. From ethically sourced crystals, rare mineral
specimens, and rare gemstones to handcrafted gemstone jewellery, The Gem Expo show offers a curated
collection that brings the magic of the earth to your fingertips.

**Discover Unique Crystals and Gemstones from Canada and Around the World**

At The Gem Expo, we showcase a wide range of natural crystals, semi-precious stones, and minerals
sourced from Canada and across the globe. You’ll find stunning pieces from:
* Canada’s mineral-rich regions, including Ontario, Alberta, and British Columbia
* Brazil’s amethyst and quartz mines
* Madagascar’s vibrant labradorite and ocean jasper
* India’s healing stones, like moonstone, apophyllite, and black tourmaline
* Morocco’s desert geodes, vanadinite clusters, and selenite products

Whether you’re looking for polished points, raw stones, geodes, beads, or rare collector specimens.
Explore our collection to learn about different gemstone names and discover your favorites, from
beginner to expert.

Handcrafted** Gemstone Jewellery by Artisan Designers**

TheGemExpo.com is also home to a diverse range of handmade gemstone jewellery crafted by local and
international artisans. Each piece is thoughtfully crafted using genuine stones and sterling silver,
making them perfect for gift-giving, spiritual work, or personal style.
* Sterling silver gemstone rings, bracelets, earrings, and pendants with real gemstones
* Gem rings featuring aquamarine stone, tourmaline stone, and other precious varieties
* Birthstone jewellery personalized for every month
* Chakra bracelets and energy-clearing tools
* One-of-a-kind statement pieces you won’t find anywhere else

**A Trusted Name in the Rock and Gem Show & Mineral Community**

The Gem Expo gem show Toronto is the largest mineral and gem show, and is held three times a year.
The show brings together many trusted vendors, artists, and collectors.
* Authentic crystals, minerals, and jewellery from verified vendors
* Items curated by passionate collectors and gemologists
* New inventory with new stones and metaphysical tools is brought in every show
* Support small Canadian businesses and independent artisans with every purchase

**Start Exploring Today**

From healing crystals and chakra stones to beautifully crafted gemstone jewellery, from raw minerals
to beads, The Gem Expo is your trusted source for earth’s natural treasures.

Join thousands of collectors, crystal healers, and jewellery lovers who believe in the beauty,
energy, and story behind every stone.

**Sri Lanka Pavilion – Special for the November 27-29 Expo**

At the request of Raytronics Lanka Pvt Ltd (Sri Lanka) and International ASEAN Corporation Inc.
(Canada), The Gem Expo has designated a dedicated Sri Lanka Pavilion within the exhibition. This
special section will showcase and promote Sri Lankan gemstones, fine jewellery, investment
opportunities, Ceylon spices, and other value-added Sri Lankan products and services. The initiative
is intended to strengthen trade, investment, and business partnerships between Sri Lanka and Canada
while highlighting the quality, heritage, and global competitiveness of Sri Lankan industries.

## Award Winning Band

The GemsTones have been recognized for their outstanding performances in over a dozen cities across
Massachusetts. They are proud to partner with the Mass Cultural Council to bring their authentic
spin on a classic sound all across the state.

## What Others Say

“Probably the most fun entertainment we have been able to provide for our residents (and staff). We
loved the band’s energy, and the music absolutely transported us back in time. You really cannot sit
still!”
Jil Greeley
Windham Terrace
“The GemsTones performed at Henniker Brewing Co. this summer 2023 and certainly brought the party to
our backyard biergarten. Their classic 50’s rock was a hit with the locals, and we’ve received
multiple requests to have them back as soon as possible. They’ve got the look, and the talent to
make any evening memorable.”
John Taylor
Henniker Brewing Company
“The GemsTones deliver perfect renditions of my favorite tunes from the golden age of rock n’ roll.
These guys are the real deal, making classic music sound fresh as when I first heard it in the 50’s.
Their professionalism and attention to detail is top notch.”
Howard Salt
The Cam Snappers Vintage Car Club

### Our Story

The Rare Gemstone Company has been a leading miner and cutter of fine gemstones since 1974. Based at
the source of one of the world’s most exciting gem producing areas we are in the enviable position
to be able to select out the very best rough crystals as they come out of the mines.

With almost half a century in the industry, in-house cutting center and master cutters, close
connections with mine owners in East Africa and long experience running colored stone mines, we
offer a vertically integrated service from the mine to the end consumer bypassing the established
old chain of distribution and its many built in markups. Our extensive network of miners provide us
with the opportunity to have first viewing and selection of all new strikes and production from the
mines.

### Our Story

The Rare Gemstone Company has been a leading miner and cutter of fine gemstones since 1974. Based at
the source of one of the world’s most exciting gem producing areas we are in the enviable position
to be able to select out the very best rough crystals as they come out of the mines.

With almost half a century in the industry, in-house cutting center and master cutters, close
connections with mine owners in East Africa and long experience running colored stone mines, we
offer a vertically integrated service from the mine to the end consumer bypassing the established
old chain of distribution and its many built in markups. Our extensive network of miners provide us
with the opportunity to have first viewing and selection of all new strikes and production from the
mines.

## Frequently Asked Questions

1. Why is Jaipur known as the gemstone capital of the world?
Jaipur is renowned as the global gemstone hub due to its centuries-old lapidary heritage, highly
skilled generational artisans, and massive infrastructure dedicated to cutting, polishing, and
trading colored precious and semi-precious stones. It handles a significant share of the world’s
colored gemstone processing and export demand.
2. What types of gemstones are manufactured in Jaipur?
Jaipur manufacturers produce a wide variety of colored gemstones, including both precious stones
(like Emerald, Ruby, and Sapphire) and semi-precious stones (such as Amethyst, Topaz, Garnet,
Tourmaline, Aquamarine, and Peridot) in various custom shapes, cabochons, and beads.
3. How do I verify if a gemstone manufacturer in Jaipur is authentic and reliable?
To verify a manufacturer, check for standardized industry memberships, ask for recognized
gemological laboratory certificates (such as GIA, IGI, or local reputed labs) for authenticity,
review their export history, and request physical or video sample parcels before placing bulk
orders.
4. Can I get custom-cut and calibrated gemstones from Jaipur manufacturers?
Yes, most professional gemstone manufacturers in Jaipur specialize in custom-cut dimensions,
specific millimeter (mm) sizing, and calibrated shapes (like oval, cushion, pear, and round)
tailored precisely to jewelry mounting and mass production specifications.
5. Do Jaipur gemstone manufacturers supply loose stones for wholesale and B2B buyers?
Absolutely. Jaipur functions primarily as a major B2B and wholesale manufacturing hub, supplying
loose calibrated stones, matched pairs for earrings, and multi-stone parcels directly to
international jewelry designers, retail brands, and wholesalers.
6. Are gemstones manufactured in Jaipur natural or treated?
Jaipur manufacturers supply both completely natural (untreated) gemstones and traditionally
enhanced/treated stones (such as heat-treated sapphires or oil-infused emeralds). Reputable
manufacturers transparently disclose any treatments or enhancements applied to the gemstones.
7. How do I place a bulk or custom order with a gemstone manufacturer in Jaipur?

You can initiate an order by reaching out directly via their official channels (such as[ Utsav
Gems][31]), specifying your required stone type, carat weight, size tolerances, calibration needs,
and shape. Trusted suppliers typically provide a sample batch or photos/videos of the exact lot for
your approval prior to bulk production.

8. What are the advantages of sourcing gemstones directly from a manufacturer in Jaipur instead of a
middleman?
Sourcing directly from a manufacturer eliminates middleman markups, ensuring better wholesale
pricing, consistent quality control, reliable availability of matched color parcels, and the
flexibility to get bespoke cutting and carving done to exact specifications.
9. Do Jaipur gemstone manufacturers cater to international shipping and export documentation?
Yes, established manufacturers in Jaipur regularly export worldwide. They handle secure, insured
transit packaging and provide necessary compliance and export documentation required for smooth
international customs clearance.
10. What is the typical turnaround/lead time for custom gemstone manufacturing orders in Jaipur?
Turnaround times vary depending on the rarity of the rough material, the volume of the order, and
the complexity of the cuts. Standard calibrated stock items ship immediately, whereas custom-cut or
specialized bulk manufacturing runs can range anywhere from 1 to 4 weeks.

## Frequently asked questions

Common questions about our services, process, and approach.

### What types of websites do you build?

We design and build custom websites for businesses of all sizes, from simple brochure sites to
complex web applications. Our focus is on creating fast, accessible, and conversion-optimized
experiences that work seamlessly across all devices. Every project is tailored to your specific
goals and audience needs.

### How long does a typical project take?

Project timelines vary based on scope and complexity. A standard business website typically takes
4-6 weeks from kickoff to launch, including design, development, content integration, and testing.
More complex projects with custom functionality may take 8-12 weeks. We provide detailed timelines
during the planning phase and keep you updated throughout.

### Do you work with existing websites or only build new ones?

We work with both. Many clients come to us with existing sites that need performance improvements,
redesigns, or technical upgrades. We can audit your current site, identify opportunities, and
implement targeted improvements. We also build new sites from scratch when that's the better path
forward.

### What's included in your performance optimization service?

Performance optimization includes Core Web Vitals improvements, image optimization, code
minification, caching strategies, CDN configuration, and database query optimization where
applicable. We measure before and after metrics, identify bottlenecks, and implement solutions that
deliver measurable speed improvements for your visitors.

### Can you help with content strategy and SEO?

Yes. While we're not a traditional content agency, we help structure sites for discoverability,
implement technical foundations properly, and guide content planning that aligns with how search
engines understand websites. We focus on the technical fundamentals that make content work
effectively rather than keyword chasing or ranking promises.

### What automation services do you offer?

We build practical automation workflows for repetitive tasks: analytics reporting, data
synchronization between platforms, content workflow automation, and monitoring alerts. These are
focused on saving time and reducing manual work, not speculative AI experiments. We assess your
actual needs and implement reliable, maintainable solutions.

### Do you offer ongoing support after launch?

Yes. We offer flexible support arrangements including monthly retainers for ongoing maintenance,
ad-hoc support for specific needs, and project-based work for new features or improvements. Many
clients work with us long-term as their digital needs evolve.

### What makes your approach different?

We prioritize technical quality over trends, real performance over vanity metrics, and sustainable
solutions over quick fixes. Our work is guided by web standards, accessibility principles, and
measurable outcomes. We're transparent about what works, what doesn't, and why. No hype, no
unnecessary complexity, just solid work that serves your goals.

## Ready to start a project?

Let's discuss your goals and explore how we can help you build a better digital presence.

## Frequently asked questions

### What types of websites do you build?

We design and build custom websites for businesses of all sizes, from simple brochure sites to
complex web applications. Our focus is on creating fast, accessible, and conversion-optimized
experiences that work seamlessly across all devices. Every project is tailored to your specific
goals and audience needs.

### How long does a typical project take?

Project timelines vary based on scope and complexity. A standard business website typically takes
4-6 weeks from kickoff to launch, including design, development, content integration, and testing.
More complex projects with custom functionality may take 8-12 weeks. We provide detailed timelines
during the planning phase and keep you updated throughout.

### Do you work with existing websites or only build new ones?

We work with both. Many clients come to us with existing sites that need performance improvements,
redesigns, or technical upgrades. We can audit your current site, identify opportunities, and
implement targeted improvements. We also build new sites from scratch when that's the better path
forward.

### What's included in your performance optimization service?

Performance optimization includes Core Web Vitals improvements, image optimization, code
minification, caching strategies, CDN configuration, and database query optimization where
applicable. We measure before and after metrics, identify bottlenecks, and implement solutions that
deliver measurable speed improvements for your visitors.

Yes. While we're not a traditional content agency, we help structure sites for discoverability,
implement technical foundations properly, and guide content planning that aligns with how search
engines understand websites. We focus on the technical fundamentals that make content work
effectively rather than keyword chasing or ranking promises.

synchronization between platforms, content workflow automation, and monitoring alerts. These are
focused on saving time and reducing manual work, not speculative AI experiments. We assess your
actual needs and implement reliable, maintainable solutions.

Yes. We offer flexible support arrangements including monthly retainers for ongoing maintenance,
ad-hoc support for specific needs, and project-based work for new features or improvements. Many
clients work with us long-term as their digital needs evolve.

### What makes your approach different?

We prioritize technical quality over trends, real performance over vanity metrics, and sustainable
solutions over quick fixes. Our work is guided by web standards, accessibility principles, and
measurable outcomes. We're transparent about what works, what doesn't, and why. No hype, no
unnecessary complexity, just solid work that serves your goals.

# Investujeme do drahých kameňov s výnosom až 19% p.a.. A vy môžete investovať s nami.

Hodnota drahokamov a zlata odoláva vojnám, krízam aj pandémiám. Staňte sa aj vy partnerom
spoločnosti WIC Global SE **a investujte s nami do večnej hodnoty drahých kameňov.**

## vyťažených drahých kameňov

## Investícia do spoločnosti na ťažbu a spracovanie drahokamov je správna investícia aj pre vás

## [WIC DIAMOND][38]

## Investovanie od 20 000 €

## Náš základný produkt pre stredných a veľkých investorov s počiatočným vkladom od 20 000 €. WIC
## Diamond je ideálnym riešením na vytvorenie dlhodobého pasívneho a bezpečného príjmu.

[ Viac informácií ][39]

## [WIC GOLD][40]

## Investovanie od 1 000 €

## Novinka v našom portfóliu pre začínajúcich investorov s počiatočným vkladom 1 000 € a následnými
## mesačnými investíciami. Vďaka WIC Gold dokážete budovať svoje osobné bohatstvo postupne a
## bezpečne.

[ Viac informácií ][41]

## Limitovaná zberateľská zlatá medaila vytvorená z 24 karátového zlata a obohatená o 1 karátový
## tanzanit. Emisia medailí je stanovená len na 100 kusov.

[ Viac informácií ][43]

## Neviete sa rozhodnúť?

[ Stretnime sa a spýtate sa na všetko ][44]

## Ako funguje investovanie do WIC Global SE?

## WIC Global SE ťaží zlato a drahokamy vo vlastných baniach v Tanzánii. Vyťažené drahé kamene
## spracováva a vytvára dizajnérske skvosty s vlastnou značkou.

## Finálne luxusné šperky predáva v sieti vlastných klenotníctiev pod značkou Soloom, čo generuje
## spoločnosti výnos.

## Investície investorov sú zabezpečené fyzickým šperkom s vysokou hodnotou.

## Svojím investovaním sa stávate akcionárom (spolumajiteľom spoločnosti WIC Global SE) s priamym
## podielom na ročnom výnose spoločnosti, ktorý je v priemere 19 % p.a..

## Investičná kalkulačka WIC DIAMOND

## Vďaka našej investičnej kalkulačke si jednoducho vypočítate zhodnotenie vašich peňazí. Stačí si
## iba nastaviť prvotnú investíciu a počet rokov, počas ktorých chcete investovať.

## Priemerný ročný výnos je 19 % p.a., a je vypočítaný z priemeru predchádzajúcich 2 rokov.
## Kalkulačka zahrňa zložené úročenie.

Jednorazový vklad: 25000 €
Doba investovania: 10 rokov

[ Stretnime sa a spýtate sa na všetko ][45]

## Predstavenie spoločnosti WIC Global SE

## Sme WIC Global SE, európska akciová investičná spoločnosť úzko špecializovaná na drahé kamene
## a šperky. Ako súčasť skupiny spoločností združených pod hlavičkou WIC Global SE kontrolujeme celý
## proces od ťažby až po finálny produkt. Vďaka našej priamej prítomnosti pri bohatom zdroji
## drahokamov a zlata v Tanzánii dokážeme prinášať jedinečné výnosy z týchto vekmi overených
## komodít.
